{"headword":"diagnose","explanation":"動詞「診斷」。指通過檢查症狀來確定疾病。常用搭配：diagnose someone with something (診斷某人患有某病)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The doctor used a variety of tests to <target>diagnose</target> the patient's illness and start the correct treatment as soon as possible.","translation":"醫生使用多種測試來診斷病人的疾病，以便盡快開始正確的治療。","explanation":"動詞「診斷」。指醫學上的診斷過程。"},{"sentence":"After a series of medical examinations, he was <target>diagnosed</target> <pattern>with</pattern> a rare blood disease that required immediate surgery.","translation":"經過一系列醫療檢查後，他被診斷患有一種罕見的血液疾病，需要立即手術。","explanation":"動詞「診斷」。常用搭配 diagnose someone with something (診斷某人患有某病)。"}],"related_forms":["diagnosis"]}

{"headword":"diagnosis","explanation":"名詞「診斷」。指診斷疾病後的結果或結論。常用搭配：make a diagnosis (做出診斷)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The patient sought a second opinion from another specialist to confirm the initial <target>diagnosis</target> made by the first doctor.","translation":"病人尋求另一位專家的第二意見，以確認第一位醫生所做的初步診斷。","explanation":"名詞「診斷」。指診斷的結果。"},{"sentence":"Early <target>diagnosis</target> <pattern>of</pattern> most cancers is crucial for improving the survival rate and the quality of life for patients.","translation":"對大多數癌症的早期診斷對於提高病人的生存率和生活品質至關重要。","explanation":"名詞「診斷」。常用搭配 diagnosis of sth。"}],"related_forms":["diagnose"]}

{"headword":"dialect","explanation":"名詞「方言」。指特定地區或社會群體所使用的語言變體。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although they both speak Mandarin, the <target>dialect</target> spoken in Taiwan is slightly different from that spoken in Beijing.","translation":"雖然他們都說普通話，但台灣說的方言與北京說的略有不同。","explanation":"名詞「方言」。指同一語言在不同地區的差異。"},{"sentence":"The linguist traveled to remote villages to record the local <target>dialects</target>, hoping to preserve the unique cultural heritage of the area.","translation":"語言學家前往偏遠村莊記錄當地的方言，希望保存該地區獨特的文化遺產。","explanation":"名詞「方言」。指特定地區使用的語言。"}],"related_forms":["dialectal"]}

{"headword":"diameter","explanation":"名詞「直徑」。指圓形或球體通過中心點且兩端在圓周上的直線距離。","entries":[{"sentence":"In the geometry class, the teacher showed us how to calculate the <target>diameter</target> <pattern>of</pattern> a circle if we already know its radius.","translation":"在幾何課上，老師向我們展示了如果已知半徑，該如何計算圓的直徑。","explanation":"名詞「直徑」。常用搭配 diameter of a circle。"},{"sentence":"The large pipe had a <target>diameter</target> <pattern>of</pattern> ten centimeters, which was enough to allow a large amount of water to flow through.","translation":"這根大管子的直徑為十公分，足以讓大量的水流過。","explanation":"名詞「直徑」。指物體的直徑長度。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"diaper","explanation":"名詞「尿布」。指給嬰兒使用的吸水墊。","entries":[{"sentence":"New parents often find it challenging to change a baby's <target>diaper</target> for the first time, but they soon get used to it.","translation":"新手父母通常會發現第一次幫嬰兒換尿布很有挑戰性，但他們很快就會習慣。","explanation":"名詞「尿布」。"},{"sentence":"The baby was crying loudly because his <target>diaper</target> was wet, and his mother quickly changed it to make him feel comfortable.","translation":"baby 正在大聲哭泣，因為他的尿布濕了，所以他的母親趕快幫他換掉，讓他感到舒適。","explanation":"名詞「尿布」。"}],"related_forms":["diapers"]}

{"headword":"digestion","explanation":"名詞「消化」。指身體將食物分解為營養物質的生物過程。","entries":[{"sentence":"Eating slowly and chewing your food carefully can help improve your <target>digestion</target> and prevent stomach pain after meals.","translation":"慢慢地吃並仔細地咀嚼食物可以幫助改善你的消化並防止餐後胃痛。","explanation":"名詞「消化」。指生物學上的消化過程。"}],"related_forms":["digest"]}

{"headword":"dilemma","explanation":"名詞「困境」。指必須在兩個或多個同樣不理想的選擇之間做出決定時的困難情況。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student faced a difficult <target>dilemma</target> when he had to choose between attending his best friend's birthday party and studying for the final exam.","translation":"這名學生面臨一個困難的困境，因為他必須在參加最好的朋友的生日派對和準備期末考之間做出選擇。","explanation":"名詞「困境」。指在兩個不理想的選擇之間猶豫。"},{"sentence":"The city government is in a <target>dilemma</target> <pattern>over</pattern> whether to build a new highway to reduce traffic, or to protect the forest.","translation":"市政府在是否要建造一新高速公路以減少交通擁堵，或是保護森林之間陷入了困境。","explanation":"名詞「困境」。常用搭配 dilemma over sth。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"dimension","explanation":"名詞「維度、尺寸、方面」。在 GSAT 中，常指物體的長寬高，或指問題、情況的某個層面或面向 (an aspect of a situation)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The architect carefully measured every <target>dimension</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the room to ensure that the new furniture would fit perfectly inside.","translation":"建築師仔細測量了房間的每個尺寸，以確保新家具能完美地放入其中。","explanation":"名詞「尺寸」。指物體的物理量度。"},{"sentence":"The discovery of new evidence added a whole new <target>dimension</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the investigation, making the case far more complex than before.","translation":"新證據的發現為調查增加了一個全新的面向，使得這個案件比之前複雜得多。","explanation":"名詞「面向、層面」。常用搭配：add a dimension to sth。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"diminish","explanation":"動詞「減少、降低、削弱」。常用於描述數量、強度、重要性或價值的下降。注意與 decrease, reduce 的區別：diminish 較常指漸漸地減少或使其變得不重要。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company's profits began to <target>diminish</target> <pattern>over time</pattern> as more competitors entered the market with cheaper products.","translation":"隨著更多競爭對手以更便宜的產品進入市場，該公司的利潤隨著時間而逐漸減少。","explanation":"動詞「減少」。指數量或價值的下降。"},{"sentence":"Despite the politician's efforts to explain his actions, the public's trust in him continued to <target>diminish</target> after the scandal.","translation":"儘管這位政治家努力解釋他的行為，但在醜聞發生後，大眾對他的信任持續降低。","explanation":"動詞「降低、削弱」。指抽象的強度或信任感的下降。"}],"related_forms":["diminished","diminishing"]}

{"headword":"diplomatic","explanation":"形容詞「外交的；圓滑的」。前者指國家間的正式關係，後者指在處理人際關係時非常有技巧且不冒犯他人。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two countries sent <target>diplomatic</target> <pattern>missions</pattern> to each other's capitals to improve their trade relations and maintain peace.","translation":"兩國向彼此的首都派遣了外交使團，以改善貿易關係並維持和平。","explanation":"形容詞「外交的」。常用搭配：diplomatic mission (外交使團), diplomatic relations (外交關係)。"},{"sentence":"When the team members disagreed, the captain used a <target>diplomatic</target> <pattern>approach</pattern> to resolve the conflict without offending anyone.","translation":"當團隊成員意見不合時，隊長採用了一種圓滑的方式來解決衝突，而沒有冒犯任何人。","explanation":"形容詞「圓滑的」。指處理問題時有技巧且得體。"}],"related_forms":["diplomacy","diplomat"]}

{"headword":"directory","explanation":"名詞「指南、名錄、目錄」。常用於指包含姓名、地址或電話的清單，或在電腦系統中指儲存檔案的資料夾。","entries":[{"sentence":"If you cannot find the office number, you can check the local telephone <target>directory</target> to search for the company's contact information.","translation":"如果你找不到辦公室電話，你可以查看當地電話簿以搜尋該公司的聯繫資訊。","explanation":"名詞「名錄、電話簿」。"},{"sentence":"The computer science teacher showed the students how to organize their files into different <target>directories</target> to keep their work tidy.","translation":"電腦科學老師向學生展示如何將檔案整理到不同的目錄中，以保持工作整潔。","explanation":"名詞「目錄」。在電腦術語中指 folder (資料夾)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"disapprove","explanation":"動詞「不贊成、反對」。常用搭配為 disapprove of sth/sb，表示對某事或某人的行為感到不滿或認為是不正確的。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many parents <target>disapprove</target> <pattern>of</pattern> their children spending too much time on social media instead of studying for their exams.","translation":"許多父母不贊成孩子花太多時間在社群媒體上，而不是準備考試。","explanation":"動詞「不贊成」。常用片語 disapprove of sth。"},{"sentence":"The school board <target>disapproved</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the new dress code policy because they believed it was too strict for the students.","translation":"學校董事會反對新的服裝規定政策，因為他們認為對學生來說太嚴格了。","explanation":"動詞「反對」。常用片語 disapprove of sth。"}],"related_forms":["disapproval"]}

{"headword":"disclose","explanation":"動詞「揭露、公開」。指將原本秘密或不為人知的事情讓大眾知道。注意與 reveal 相似，但 disclose 較常在正式或法律語境中使用。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company is legally required to <target>disclose</target> <pattern>all</pattern> financial information to its shareholders before the annual meeting.","translation":"公司在年度會議前被法律要求向股東公開所有財務資訊。","explanation":"動詞「公開」。常用於正式的資訊披露。"},{"sentence":"The witness refused to <target>disclose</target> <pattern>the identity of</pattern> the other people involved in the case to protect their safety.","translation":"證人拒絕透露參與本案其他人的身份，以保護他們的安全。","explanation":"動詞「揭露」。常用搭配 disclose the identity of sb。"}],"related_forms":["disclosure"]}

{"headword":"disconnect","explanation":"動詞「切斷、中斷」。可用於物理上的切斷（如電線）或抽象上的中斷（如通訊或情感聯繫）。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please remember to <target>disconnect</target> the power cord <pattern>from</pattern> the wall outlet before you try to repair the electrical appliance.","translation":"在嘗試修理電器之前，請記得將電源線從牆上的插座切斷。","explanation":"動詞「切斷」。常用搭配 disconnect sth from sth。"},{"sentence":"The sudden power outage caused the internet connection to <target>disconnect</target>, making it impossible for the student to submit his online assignment.","translation":"突然的停電導致網路連接中斷，使該學生無法提交他的線上作業。","explanation":"動詞「中斷」。指通訊或信號的停止。"}],"related_forms":["disconnected","disconnection"]}

{"headword":"discourse","explanation":"名詞「論述、演說、對話」。在學術語境中，指關於某個主題的正式討論或對話方式。","entries":[{"sentence":"The professor's lecture provided a deep analysis of the political <target>discourse</target> <pattern>surrounding</pattern> the new environmental laws in the country.","translation":"教授的講座對該國新環境法 surrounding 的政治論述進行了深入分析。","explanation":"名詞「論述」。指對特定主題的正式討論。"},{"sentence":"In the advanced English class, students are encouraged to engage in a civil <target>discourse</target> <pattern>about</pattern> complex social issues to develop critical thinking.","translation":"在高級英文課中，學生被鼓勵就複雜的社會議題進行文明的對話，以培養批判性思考。","explanation":"名詞「對話、討論」。常用搭配 discourse about sth。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"discriminate","explanation":"動詞「歧視；辨別」。前者是指不公平地對待他人，後者是指區分兩者之間的差異。注意搭配 disapprove of 與 discriminate against 區分。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is illegal and unfair to <target>discriminate</target> <pattern>against</pattern> job applicants based on their age, gender, or ethnic background.","translation":"根據年齡、身體素質或種族背景而歧視求職者是不合法且不公平的。","explanation":"動詞「歧視」。常用片語 discriminate against sb。"},{"sentence":"A trained musician can easily <target>discriminate</target> <pattern>between</pattern> the sounds of a piano and a harpsichord, even from a distance.","translation":"一名受過訓練的音樂家可以輕易地辨別鋼琴和撥弦古琴的聲音，即使在遠處也能辨別。","explanation":"動詞「辨別」。常用片語 discriminate between A and B。"}],"related_forms":["discriminatory","discrimination"]}

{"headword":"discrimination","explanation":"名詞「歧視；辨別」。指不公平的對待或區分能力。注意 discrimination against sb 為常用考點。","entries":[{"sentence":"The organization works hard to fight racial <target>discrimination</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the workplace to ensure every employee is treated with respect.","translation":"該組織努力在職場中對抗種族歧視，以確保每位員工都受到尊重。","explanation":"名詞「歧視」。常用搭配 discrimination in the workplace。"},{"sentence":"The student's ability to make a fine <target>discrimination</target> <pattern>between</pattern> different types of soil was praised by the science teacher.","translation":"這名學生能精準辨別不同類型土壤的能力受到了科學老師的讚賞。","explanation":"名詞「辨別」。指區分不同事物的能力。"}],"related_forms":["discriminate","discriminatory"]}

{"headword":"disrupt","explanation":"動詞「打斷、擾亂」。常用於描述對流程、計劃或活動的干擾。常考搭配 disrupt the process/meeting/class。","entries":[{"sentence":"The sudden power outage <target>disrupted</target> the online exam, causing many students to lose their progress and feel anxious.","translation":"突然的停電打斷了線上考試，導致許多學生失去進度並感到焦慮。","explanation":"動詞「打斷」。指對某個持續過程的干擾。"},{"sentence":" construction work on the main road <target>disrupted</target> the morning traffic, forcing many commuters to take a different route to work.","translation":"主幹道上的施工擾亂了早晨的交通，迫使許多通勤者採取不同的路徑上班。","explanation":"動詞「擾亂」。指對公共秩序或交通的干擾。"},{"sentence":"The teacher asked the students to stop talking because their loud voices <target>disrupted</target> <pattern>the flow of</pattern> the lecture.","translation":"老師要求學生停止說話，因為他們大聲的聲音打斷了講座的流暢度。","explanation":"動詞「打斷」。常用搭配：disrupt the flow of sth。"}],"related_forms":["disruption"]}

{"headword":"dissolve","explanation":"動詞「溶解」或「解散」。在科學語境中指物質溶於液體；在法律或組織語境中指團體或合約的終結。常考搭配 dissolve in (溶於), dissolve a partnership (解散合夥關係)。","entries":[{"sentence":"To make the solution, you need to <target>dissolve</target> the sugar <pattern>in</pattern> warm water and stir it until it completely disappears.","translation":"為了製作溶液，你需要將糖溶解在溫水中，並攪拌直到它完全消失。","explanation":"動詞「溶解」。常用搭配：dissolve in sth。"},{"sentence":"The parliament was <target>dissolved</target> by the government, leading to a general election to choose new representatives for the people.","translation":"議會被政府解散，導致舉行大選以選出人民的新代表。","explanation":"動詞「解散」。指正式終結一個組織或議會。"},{"sentence":"After years of disagreement, the two business partners decided to <target>dissolve</target> <pattern>their partnership</pattern> and start their own separate companies.","translation":"經過多年的分歧，兩位生意夥伴決定解散他們的合夥關係，並各自創立自己的公司。","explanation":"動詞「解散」。指終結合約或合作關係。"}],"related_forms":["dissolution","dissolvable"]}

{"headword":"distinction","explanation":"名詞「區別」或「卓越」。指兩者之間的差異，或指某人在學業或成就上的卓越表現。常用片語 make a distinction between A and B。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is important to <target>make a distinction</target> <pattern>between</pattern> a fact and an opinion when analyzing a news article for a school project.","translation":"在為學校專題分析新聞文章時，區分事實與意見是很重要的。","explanation":"名詞「區別」。常用搭配：make a distinction between A and B。"},{"sentence":"The two species of birds look very similar, but there is a clear <target>distinction</target> <pattern>in</pattern> their singing patterns and behaviors.","translation":"這兩種鳥類看起來非常相似，但它們的鳴叫模式和行為有明顯的區別。","explanation":"名詞「區別」。常用搭配：distinction in sth。"},{"sentence":"She graduated from the university <pattern>with</pattern> <target>distinction</target>, receiving the highest honors for her outstanding academic achievements in biology.","translation":"她以優等成績從大學畢業，因其在生物學方面的卓越學業成就而獲得最高榮譽。","explanation":"名詞「卓越、優等」。常用搭配：with distinction。"}],"related_forms":["distinct","distinctive"]}

{"headword":"distinctive","explanation":"形容詞「獨特的、有特色的」。指某物具有與他人不同的特質，使其容易被辨識。注意與 distinct (明顯的、不同的) 的區別：distinctive 強調的是特徵，而 distinct 側重於邊界明確或數量分明。","entries":[{"sentence":"The zebra has <target>distinctive</target> black and white stripes, which help it blend into the grass to hide from predators.","translation":"斑馬有獨特的黑白條紋，這有助於它融入草叢以躲避掠食者。","explanation":"形容詞「獨特的」。指具有辨識度的特徵。"},{"sentence":"The smell of fresh cinnamon rolls is very <target>distinctive</target>, making it easy to recognize the bakery as soon as you enter the street.","translation":"新鮮肉桂捲的味道非常獨特，讓你一進入街道就能輕易辨識出那家麵包店。","explanation":"形容詞「獨特的」。指感官上的獨特特徵。"},{"sentence":"Each artist has a <target>distinctive</target> <pattern>style of</pattern> painting, which allows critics to identify their work without seeing the signature.","translation":"每位藝術家都有獨特的繪畫風格，這讓評論家無需看到簽名就能辨識出他們的作品。","explanation":"形容詞「獨特的」。常用搭配：distinctive style of sth。"}],"related_forms":["distinct","distinction"]}

{"headword":"distract","explanation":"動詞「分心、分散注意力」。常考搭配 distract someone from sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"The loud noise from the construction site <target>distracted</target> the students <pattern>from</pattern> their studies, making it hard to concentrate on the test.","translation":"建築工地傳來的巨大噪音讓學生們分心，無法專注於考試。","explanation":"動詞「分心」。常用搭配：distract someone from sth。"},{"sentence":"The mother tried to <target>distract</target> her crying baby <pattern>with</pattern> a colorful toy to stop him from feeling scared during the doctor's visit.","translation":"母親試圖用一個彩色玩具吸引哭泣寶寶的注意力，以免他在看醫生時感到害怕。","explanation":"動詞「分心/吸引注意力」。常用搭配：distract someone with sth。"},{"sentence":"I tried to focus on the teacher's explanation, but the beautiful view outside the window <target>distracted</target> me <pattern>from</pattern> the lesson.","translation":"我試圖專注於老師的解釋，但窗外美麗的景色讓我對課堂分心。","explanation":"動詞「分心」。指注意力被其他事物吸引而移開。"}],"related_forms":["distraction","distracted"]}

{"headword":"doctrine","explanation":"名詞「教義、主義、學說」。指一個組織或宗教中被視為真實且應被遵循的原則。常用於政治、法律或宗教背景。","entries":[{"sentence":"The professor explained the political <target>doctrine</target> of the 19th century, discussing how it shaped the laws and policies of the country.","translation":"教授解釋了 19 世紀的政治學說，討論它如何塑造了該國的法律和政策。","explanation":"名詞「學說」。指一套政治或社會原則。"},{"sentence":"Religious leaders often teach the core <target>doctrine</target> <pattern>of</pattern> their faith to ensure that all members follow the same beliefs and values.","translation":"宗教領袖經常教授其信仰的核心教義，以確保所有成員遵循相同的信仰和價值觀。","explanation":"名詞「教義」。常用搭配：doctrine of sth。"},{"sentence":"The court's decision was based on a legal <target>doctrine</target> that protects the privacy of individuals even in public spaces.","translation":"法院的裁決是基於一項保護個人在公共空間隱私的法律原則。","explanation":"名詞「法律原則」。指法律上的既定準則。"}],"related_forms":["doctrinal"]}

{"headword":"document","explanation":"名詞「文件」；動詞「記錄」。名詞用法極其常見；動詞用法指用文字、影像或數據記錄下來以供後續參考。常考搭配 document the process/history。","entries":[{"sentence":"Please make sure to sign the official <target>document</target> and return it to the administration office by Friday afternoon.","translation":"請確保在週五下午前簽署正式文件並將其交回行政辦公室。","explanation":"名詞「文件」。指正式的紙本或電子記錄。"},{"sentence":"The historian spent years traveling to different cities to <target>document</target> the stories of survivors from the ancient war.","translation":"歷史學家花了好幾年時間旅行到不同城市，記錄倖存者關於那場古代戰爭的故事。","explanation":"動詞「記錄」。指詳細地記錄事實或事件。"},{"sentence":"Scientists use cameras and sensors to <target>document</target> <pattern>the behavior of</pattern> wild animals in their natural habitat for research purposes.","translation":"科學家使用相機和感測器來記錄野生動物在自然棲息地中的行為，以用於研究目的。","explanation":"動詞「記錄」。常用搭配：document the behavior of sth。"}],"related_forms":["documentation"]}

{"headword":"documentary","explanation":"名詞「紀錄片」；形容詞「紀錄的、文件的」。名詞用法在 GSAT 中最為常見，指一種以事實為基礎的電影或節目。","entries":[{"sentence":"Our teacher asked us to watch a <target>documentary</target> <pattern>about</pattern> climate change and write a short reflection paper on the topic.","translation":"老師要求我們看一部關於氣候變遷的紀錄片，並就該主題寫一篇短篇反思報告。","explanation":"名詞「紀錄片」。常用搭配：documentary about sth。"},{"sentence":"The <target>documentary</target> provided a detailed look at the lives of rare birds, using real footage to show their nesting habits.","translation":"這部紀錄片詳細地展現了稀有鳥類的生活，利用真實影像來展示其築巢習性。","explanation":"名詞「紀錄片」。指以事實為基礎的影像作品。"},{"sentence":"The lawyer presented <target>documentary</target> <pattern>evidence</pattern> to the judge, including emails and letters, to prove that his client was innocent.","translation":"律師向法官提交了書面證據，包括電子郵件和信件，以證明他的當事人是清白的。","explanation":"形容詞「紀錄的、文件的」。常用搭配：documentary evidence (書面證據)。"}],"related_forms":["document"]}

{"headword":"domain","explanation":"名詞「領域、領地」。指某人的專業知識範圍，或指一個特定的地理或數位空間。常用搭配 domain of knowledge/expertise。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although he is an expert in the <target>domain</target> <pattern>of</pattern> physics, he admits that he knows very little about ancient history.","translation":"雖然他是物理學領域的專家，但他承認自己對古代歷史知之甚少。","explanation":"名詞「領域」。常用搭配：domain of sth。"},{"sentence":"The king's <target>domain</target> extended across the entire valley, including all the forests and rivers within its borders.","translation":"國王的領地延伸至整個山谷，包括其邊界內的所有森林和河流。","explanation":"名詞「領地」。指受控的地理區域。"},{"sentence":"When setting up a new website, you must register a <target>domain</target> <pattern>name</pattern> to make it easy for people to find you online.","translation":"在建立新網站時，您必須註冊一個域名，以便人們在網路上輕鬆找到您。","explanation":"名詞「域名」。常用搭配：domain name (域名)。"}],"related_forms":["domains"]}

{"headword":"dome","explanation":"名詞「圓頂」。指建築物頂部呈半球形結構。動詞用法指「使成圓頂形」。","entries":[{"sentence":"The grand cathedral's massive <target>dome</target> can be seen from miles away, making it a famous landmark of the city.","translation":"大教堂巨大的圓頂從數英里外就能被看見，使其成為該市著名的地標。","explanation":"名詞「圓頂」。指建築物頂部的半球形結構。"},{"sentence":"The researchers built a glass <target>dome</target> over the garden to protect the rare plants from the cold winter weather.","translation":"研究人員在花園上方建立了一個玻璃圓頂，以保護稀有植物免於寒冬的惡劣天氣。","explanation":"名詞「圓頂」。指保護性的圓頂結構。"},{"sentence":"The artist decided to <target>dome</target> the ceiling of the room to give the space a more elegant and open feeling.","translation":"動詞「使成圓頂形」。指將頂部設計成半球形。","explanation":"動詞用法。指建築設計上的圓頂化。"}],"related_forms":["domed"]}

{"headword":"donate","explanation":"動詞「捐贈」。指將金錢、物品或器官捐給慈善機構或他人。常用搭配 donate sth to sb/sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many generous people decided to <target>donate</target> their old clothes <pattern>to</pattern> the local charity to help families in need during the winter.","translation":"許多慷慨的人決定將他們的舊衣服捐贈給當地慈善機構，以在冬天幫助有需要的家庭。","explanation":"動詞「捐贈」。常用搭配：donate sth to sb/sth。"},{"sentence":"The university encourages students to <target>donate</target> blood <pattern>at</pattern> the campus health center to save lives and support the medical system.","translation":"大學鼓勵學生在校園健康中心捐血，以拯救生命並支持醫療系統。","explanation":"動詞「捐贈」。此處指捐血。"}],"related_forms":["donated","donating"]}

{"headword":"donation","explanation":"名詞「捐贈；捐款」。指捐贈的行為或捐贈的物品/金錢。常用搭配 make a donation to sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"The museum received a generous <target>donation</target> <pattern>from</pattern> a wealthy businessman, which allowed them to buy new artifacts for the exhibition.","translation":"博物館收到了一位富商的慷慨捐款，使他們能夠為展覽購買新的文物。","explanation":"名詞「捐款」。常用搭配：donation from sb。"},{"sentence":"The school library announced that they would accept <target>donations</target> <pattern>of</pattern> books to expand their collection and provide more resources for students.","translation":"學校圖書館宣布將接受書籍捐贈，以擴展其館藏並為學生提供更多資源。","explanation":"名詞「捐贈」。常用搭配：donation of sth。"},{"sentence":"Every student in the class <pattern>made</pattern> a small <target>donation</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the disaster relief fund to help victims of the earthquake.","translation":"班上每個學生都向災難救助基金捐了一小筆錢，以幫助地震災民。","explanation":"名詞「捐款」。片語 make a donation to sth 表示「向...捐款」。"}],"related_forms":["donations"]}

{"headword":"donor","explanation":"名詞「捐贈者」。指捐款、捐物或捐贈器官的人。常用搭配 organ donor (器官捐贈者), blood donor (捐血者)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The hospital expressed deep gratitude to the anonymous <target>donor</target> who provided the kidney needed for the patient's life-saving surgery.","translation":"醫院對那位提供病人救命手術所需腎臟的匿名捐贈者表達了深切的感激。","explanation":"名詞「捐贈者」。指捐贈器官的人。"},{"sentence":"To become a blood <target>donor</target>, you must meet certain health requirements to ensure both the donor and the recipient are safe.","translation":"要成為一名捐血者，你必須符合某些健康要求，以確保捐贈者和接收者都安全。","explanation":"名詞「捐血者」。"}],"related_forms":["donors"]}

{"headword":"doorway","explanation":"名詞「門口；門道」。指進入房間或建築物的通道。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher stood in the <target>doorway</target>, smiling and welcoming the students as they entered the classroom for the first day of school.","translation":"老師站在門口，微笑著歡迎學生進入教室，開始第一天的學校生活。","explanation":"名詞「門口」。"},{"sentence":"A small cat was sitting quietly in the <target>doorway</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the old house, watching the people passing by on the street.","translation":"一隻小貓靜靜地坐在老房子的門口，看著街上經過的人們。","explanation":"名詞「門口」。常用搭配：doorway of sth。"}],"related_forms":["doorways"]}

{"headword":"dough","explanation":"名詞「麵糰」。指混合了麵粉和水或其他成分後的黏稠物質。","entries":[{"sentence":"After mixing the flour and water, the baker <pattern>kneaded</pattern> the <target>dough</target> with his hands to make the bread soft and fluffy.","translation":"將麵粉和水混合後，麵包師傅用手揉麵糰，使麵包口感柔軟且蓬鬆。","explanation":"名詞「麵糰」。常用搭配：knead dough (揉麵糰)。"},{"sentence":"The children enjoyed <target>dough</target> <pattern>for</pattern> cookies, shaping them into stars and hearts before putting them into the oven.","translation":"孩子們喜歡製作餅乾麵糰，在放入烤箱前將其塑造成星星和心形。","explanation":"名詞「麵糰」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"dreadful","explanation":"形容詞「可怕的；糟糕的」。可用於描述天氣、情況或品質極差的事物。注意與 terrible, awful 同義。","entries":[{"sentence":"The weather during the class trip was <target>dreadful</target>, with heavy rain and strong winds that forced the students to stay indoors.","translation":"校外教學期間的天氣糟糕透頂，大雨和強風迫使學生們留在室內。","explanation":"形容詞「糟糕的」。用於描述天氣。"},{"sentence":"She felt a <target>dreadful</target> <pattern>sense of</pattern> guilt after realizing she had accidentally forgotten her best friend's birthday party.","translation":"在意識到自己不小心忘了好朋友的生日派對後，她感到一種可怕的愧疚感。","explanation":"形容詞「可怕的」。常用搭配：a dreadful sense of guilt。"},{"sentence":"The movie received <target>dreadful</target> reviews from critics, as the plot was confusing and the acting was very poor.","translation":"電影收到評論家的糟糕評價，因為劇情混亂且演技非常差。","explanation":"形容詞「糟糕的」。用於描述品質或評價。"}],"related_forms":["dreadfully"]}

{"headword":"driveway","explanation":"名詞「車道」。指從街道進入私人住宅或建築物前方的短路段。","entries":[{"sentence":"The visitor <pattern>pulled into</pattern> the <target>driveway</target> of the large house and stopped the car to wait for the owner to come out.","translation":"訪客將車開進大房子的車道，停好車後等待主人出來。","explanation":"名詞「車道」。常用搭配：pull into a driveway (將車開進車道)。"},{"sentence":"After the heavy snowfall, my father spent an hour <target>driveway</target> <pattern>clearing</pattern> the snow to make sure the car could leave the house.","translation":"大雪後，我的父親花了一小時清理車道上的積雪，以確保汽車能開出家門。","explanation":"名詞「車道」。"}],"related_forms":["driveways"]}

{"headword":"drought","explanation":"名詞「乾旱」。指長時間沒有雨水而導致的水資源不足。常用搭配 suffer from a drought (遭受乾旱)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The farmers in the region <pattern>suffered from</pattern> a severe <target>drought</target> for two years, which caused their crops to dry up and die.","translation":"該地區的農民在兩年內遭受了嚴重的乾旱，導致他們的作物乾枯而死。","explanation":"名詞「乾旱」。常用片語 suffer from a drought。"},{"sentence":"Government officials are trying to find new ways to <target>drought</target> <pattern>management</pattern> and conserve water during the dry season.","translation":"政府官員正試圖尋找新的乾旱管理方式，並在乾季期間節約用水。","explanation":"名詞「乾旱」。常用搭配：drought management。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"ecological","explanation":"形容詞「生態的」。指與生態系統（ecology）相關的。常用搭配 ecological balance (生態平衡), ecological disaster (生態災難)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The oil spill in the ocean caused a massive <target>ecological</target> <pattern>disaster</pattern>, killing thousands of sea birds and marine animals.","translation":"海洋中的漏油事故造成了巨大的生態災難，導致數千隻海鳥和海洋動物死亡。","explanation":"形容詞「生態的」。常用搭配：ecological disaster。"},{"sentence":"Environmentalists are working to maintain the <target>ecological</target> <pattern>balance</pattern> of the forest by protecting rare species of plants and animals.","translation":"環保人士正努力維持森林的生態平衡，透過保護稀有植物和動物物種。","explanation":"形容詞「生態的」。常用搭配：ecological balance。"}],"related_forms":["ecology","ecologically"]}

{"headword":"ecology","explanation":"名詞「生態學；生態」。指研究生物與環境之間關係的科學。常用搭配 study ecology (學習生態學)。","entries":[{"sentence":"In her biology class, the students <pattern>studied</pattern> <target>ecology</target> to understand how different animals and plants interact with their environment.","translation":"在生物課上，學生們學習生態學，以了解不同動物和植物如何與其環境互動。","explanation":"名詞「生態學」。"},{"sentence":"The local government is concerned about the impact of urban development on the <target>ecology</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the nearby wetland area.","translation":" ","explanation":"名詞「生態」。常用搭配：ecology of sth。"}],"related_forms":["ecological","ecologically"]}

{"headword":"ecosystem","explanation":"名詞「生態系統」。指一個區域內生物與其物理環境之間相互作用的複雜網絡。在 GSAT 考題中，常出現在環境保護、生物多樣性等議題中。常用搭配：fragile ecosystem (脆弱的生態系統), protect the ecosystem (保護生態系統)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Pollution from the nearby factory has severely damaged the local <target>ecosystem</target>, leading to a decrease in the population of native fish.","translation":"附近工廠的污染嚴重損害了當地生態系統，導致原生魚類數量減少。","explanation":"名詞「生態系統」。指生物與環境的交互作用系統。"},{"sentence":"Scientists are studying how the introduction of a non-native species can disrupt the balance of a fragile <target>ecosystem</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the rainforest.","translation":"科學家正在研究引入非原生種如何破壞雨林中脆弱生態系統的平衡。","explanation":"名詞「生態系統」。常用搭配：fragile ecosystem (脆弱的生態系統)。"}],"related_forms":["ecosystems"]}

{"headword":"ego","explanation":"名詞「自我；自尊心」。在心理學或日常對話中，常指一個人對自身能力的過度自信或傲慢。常見搭配：huge ego (巨大的自尊心), bruise someone's ego (傷到某人的自尊心)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The athlete's <target>ego</target> was <pattern>bruised</pattern> when he failed to win the gold medal, as he had always believed he was the best.","translation":"當這名運動員未能贏得金牌時，他的自尊心受損了，因為他一直相信自己是最強的。","explanation":"名詞「自尊心」。片語 bruise someone's ego 意為「傷到某人的自尊心」。"},{"sentence":"Successful leaders often need to set aside their <target>ego</target> and listen to the suggestions of their team members to achieve better results.","translation":"成功的領導者通常需要放下自尊心，傾聽團隊成員的建議，以取得更好的結果。","explanation":"名詞「自我/自尊心」。指一個人對自己的看法或自信程度。"}],"related_forms":["egos"]}

{"headword":"elaborate","explanation":"形容詞「複雜的、詳盡的」；動詞「詳盡說明」。作為形容詞時，注意與 simple 或 plain 相對；作為動詞時，常用於要求對方提供更多細節。常考片語：elaborate on something (詳盡說明某事)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The artist spent months creating an <target>elaborate</target> sculpture made of glass and metal, showing incredible attention to detail.","translation":"這位藝術家花了好幾個月時間創作了一件由玻璃和金屬製成的複雜雕塑，展現了對細節的驚人關注。","explanation":"形容詞「複雜的、詳盡的」。指設計或構造精細且複雜。"},{"sentence":"The professor asked the student to <target>elaborate</target> <pattern>on</pattern> her argument in the final essay to provide more supporting evidence.","translation":"教授要求學生在期末論文中詳盡說明她的論點，以提供更多支持證據。","explanation":"動詞片語 elaborate on sth 意為「詳盡說明某事」。"}],"related_forms":["elaboration","elaborately","elaborated"]}

{"headword":"eligible","explanation":"形容詞「符合條件的、有資格的」。常用於描述申請獎學金、參政或獲得某種權利的情況。關鍵搭配：be eligible for sth (符合...的資格), be eligible to V (有資格做某事)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Students who maintain a high grade point average are <target>eligible</target> <pattern>for</pattern> a full scholarship to study at a prestigious university.","translation":"維持高平均成績的學生有資格獲得就讀名校的全額獎學金。","explanation":"形容詞「符合條件的」。常用搭配 be eligible for + N。"},{"sentence":"After living in the country for five years, he finally became <target>eligible</target> <pattern>to</pattern> apply for citizenship and vote in the election.","translation":"在該國居住五年後，他終於有資格申請公民身份並在選舉中投票。","explanation":"形容詞「有資格的」。常用搭配 be eligible to + V。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"eloquent","explanation":"形容詞「雄辯的、有說服力的」。指一個人說話或寫作能打動人心且流暢。常用搭配：an eloquent speaker (一名雄辯的演說家), eloquent speech (有說服力的演講)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student council president gave an <target>eloquent</target> speech that inspired many of her classmates to join the environmental campaign.","translation":"學生會會長發表了一場雄辯的演講，激勵了許多同學加入環保運動。","explanation":"形容詞「雄辯的」。指表達能力強且有感染力。"},{"sentence":"Her eyes were <target>eloquent</target>, conveying a deep sense of sadness and longing that words could not fully express.","translation":"她的眼神十分傳神，傳達出一種言語無法完全表達的深深悲傷與渴望。","explanation":"形容詞「雄辯的/傳神的」。此處指非言語的表達非常清晰且有說服力。"}],"related_forms":["eloquence","eloquently"]}

{"headword":"embrace","explanation":"動詞「擁抱；接納、採納」；名詞「擁抱」。動詞用法中，「接納（想法、信仰、文化）」是 GSAT 常考的抽象用法。常用搭配：embrace a culture (接納文化), embrace an opportunity (把握機會)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After traveling through Asia, the student decided to <target>embrace</target> the local culture and learn the traditional customs of the region.","translation":"在亞洲旅行後，這名學生決定接納當地文化並學習該地區的傳統習俗。","explanation":"動詞「接納/採納」。指欣然接受某種觀念或生活方式。"},{"sentence":"The two old friends <target>embraced</target> warmly when they met at the airport after being separated for over ten years.","translation":"這兩位老朋友在分開十年多後於機場相遇，熱情地擁抱在一起。","explanation":"動詞「擁抱」。指身體上的擁抱。"},{"sentence":"The company's success came from its ability to <target>embrace</target> <pattern>new technology</pattern> and adapt to the changing needs of the market.","translation":"這家公司的成功來自於它能採納新技術並適應市場不斷變化的需求。","explanation":"動詞「接納/採納」。指接受並使用新方法或技術。"},{"sentence":"She gave her child a tight <target>embrace</target>, showing her love and protection as the boy began his first day of school.","translation":"她緊緊地擁抱著孩子，顯示出她的愛與保護，因為男孩開始了他的上學第一天。","explanation":"名詞「擁抱」。"}],"related_forms":["embraces","embraced","embracing"]}

{"headword":"emission","explanation":"名詞「排放、排放物」。常用於環境科學議題，描述溫室氣體或廢氣的排放。常用搭配：carbon emissions (碳排放), reduce emissions (減少排放), emission standards (排放標準)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many countries are working together to reduce carbon <target>emissions</target> to slow down the process of global warming and protect the planet.","translation":"許多國家正共同努力減少碳排放，以減緩全球暖化過程並保護地球。","explanation":"名詞「排放物」。常用搭配：carbon emissions (碳排放)。"},{"sentence":"The government has introduced stricter <target>emission</target> <pattern>standards</pattern> for cars to improve the air quality in crowded cities.","translation":"政府對汽車實施了更嚴格的排放標準，以改善擁擠城市的空氣品質。","explanation":"名詞「排放」。常用搭配：emission standards (排放標準)。"}],"related_forms":["emit","emissions"]}

{"headword":"endorse","explanation":"動詞「背書、支持、贊同」；名詞 endorsement「代言、支持」。在商業語境中，常指名人為產品代言；在政治語境中，常指公開支持某個候選人。常用搭配：endorse a product (為產品代言), give an endorsement (給予支持)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The famous basketball player was paid millions of dollars to <target>endorse</target> a new line of athletic shoes for a global brand.","translation":"這位著名的籃球員獲得數百萬美元的酬勞，為全球品牌的全新系列運動鞋代言。","explanation":"動詞「代言」。指名人公開推薦產品。"},{"sentence":"The local newspaper decided to <target>endorse</target> the candidate who promised to improve the public transportation system in the city.","translation":"當地報紙決定支持那位承諾改善城市大眾運輸系統的候選人。","explanation":"動詞「支持/贊同」。指公開表達對某人的支持。"},{"sentence":"The celebrity's <target>endorsement</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the organic skincare brand led to a huge increase in sales within a few months.","translation":"這位名人對有機護膚品牌的代言導致銷售額在短短幾個月內大幅增加。","explanation":"名詞「代言/支持」。常用搭配：endorsement of sth。"}],"related_forms":["endorsement","endorsed","endorsing"]}

{"headword":"enterprise","explanation":"名詞「企業、公司」或「進取心、艱巨的事業」。在 GSAT 中，最常見的意義是「企業」。常用搭配：private enterprise (私營企業), state-owned enterprise (國營企業), a spirit of enterprise (進取心)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government provides financial support to small <target>enterprises</target> to encourage innovation and create more job opportunities for young people.","translation":"政府為小型企業提供財務支持，以鼓勵創新並為年輕人創造更多就業機會。","explanation":"名詞「企業」。指從事商業活動的組織。"},{"sentence":"Starting a new business in a competitive market is a risky <target>enterprise</target> that requires a lot of courage and careful planning.","translation":"在競爭激烈的市場中創業是一項冒險的事業，需要巨大的勇氣和周密的計畫。","explanation":"名詞「事業」。指需要努力和勇氣才能完成的艱巨任務。"},{"sentence":"The young entrepreneur's spirit of <target>enterprise</target> led him to develop a new app that helps students organize their study schedules.","translation":"這位年輕創業者的進取心促使他開發了一款幫助學生安排學習進程的應用程式。","explanation":"名詞「進取心」。指主動採取行動去嘗試新事物的特質。"}],"related_forms":["enterprising"]}

{"headword":"enthusiastic","explanation":"形容詞「熱情的、熱心的」。常用於描述對某事展現出強烈興趣或興奮感的狀態。常用搭配：be enthusiastic about sth (對...感到熱情), an enthusiastic supporter (一名熱心的支持者)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students were extremely <target>enthusiastic</target> <pattern>about</pattern> the upcoming school trip to the National Palace Museum, discussing it for days.","translation":"學生們對即將到來的國立故宮博物院校外教學感到非常熱情，討論了好幾天。","explanation":"形容詞「熱情的」。常用搭配 be enthusiastic about sth。"},{"sentence":"Despite being a beginner, the new member of the choir was <target>enthusiastic</target> and practiced her songs every day with great energy.","translation":"儘管是個初學者，合唱團的新成員依然熱情且充滿能量地每天練習歌曲。","explanation":"形容詞「熱情的」。指對學習或活動展現出強烈的興趣。"},{"sentence":"The teacher was impressed by the <target>enthusiastic</target> response from the students, as they asked many thoughtful questions during the lecture.","translation":"老師對學生們熱烈的反應印象深刻，因為他們在講座期間提出了許多深思熟慮的問題。","explanation":"形容詞「熱烈的」。指反應積極且熱情。"}],"related_forms":["enthusiasm","enthusiastically"]}

{"headword":"entitle","explanation":"動詞，意為「賦予權利」或「命名」。常考用法為 entitle someone to something (賦予某人某種權利/資格) 或 be entitled to (有權享有)。注意與 title (命名) 的區別，entitle 強調的是法律、規則或資格上的權利。","entries":[{"sentence":"According to the school rules, students who maintain a high GPA are <target>entitled</target> <pattern>to</pattern> a scholarship for their university studies.","translation":"根據學校規定，維持高平均成績的學生有權獲得大學獎學金。","explanation":"動詞「賦予權利」。常用搭配：be entitled to (有權享有)。"},{"sentence":"The author decided to <target>entitle</target> her new novel \"The Silent Forest\" to reflect the mysterious atmosphere of the story.","translation":"作者決定將她的新小說命名為《沈默之林》，以反映故事中神秘的氛圍。","explanation":"動詞「命名」。"}],"related_forms":["entitlement","entitled"]}

{"headword":"entity","explanation":"名詞，意為「實體」或「獨立個體」。在 GSAT 中，常出現在學術文章或商務討論中，指代一個獨立存在的事物，如 a legal entity (法律實體/法人) 或 a separate entity (獨立實體)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two small companies merged into a single legal <target>entity</target>, allowing them to share resources and compete more effectively in the market.","translation":"這兩家小公司合併成一個單一的法律實體，使他們能夠共享資源並在市場上更有效地競爭。","explanation":"名詞「實體」。常用搭配：legal entity (法律實體)。"},{"sentence":"In philosophy, scholars often debate whether the human mind and the body are a single <target>entity</target> or two separate ones.","translation":"在哲學中，學者們經常討論人類的心智和身體是一個單一的實體，還是兩個獨立的實體。","explanation":"名詞「實體」。指代獨立存在的個體。"}],"related_forms":["entities"]}

{"headword":"entrepreneur","explanation":"名詞，意為「企業家」。指那些願意承擔風險以建立新事業的人。常考搭配為 successful entrepreneur (成功的企業家) 或 aspiring entrepreneur (有志於成為企業家的)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young <target>entrepreneur</target> started her own tech company in college, creating an innovative app that helped students organize their study schedules.","translation":"這位年輕的企業家在大學期間創立了自己的科技公司，開發了一款創新地幫助學生安排學習進度的應用程式。","explanation":"名詞「企業家」。指創立事業的人。"},{"sentence":"To become a successful <target>entrepreneur</target>, one must be willing to <pattern>take</pattern> <pattern>risks</pattern> and adapt quickly to changing market demands.","translation":"要成為一名成功的企業家，一個人必須願意承擔風險並迅速適應不斷變化的市場需求。","explanation":"名詞「企業家」。常用搭配：take risks (承擔風險)。"}],"related_forms":["entrepreneurship","entrepreneurial"]}

{"headword":"envious","explanation":"形容詞，意為「嫉妒的」。常用搭配為 envious of (嫉妒...)。注意與 jealous 的區別：envious 側重於想要擁有他人擁有的東西或特質；而 jealous 側重於擔心失去自己擁有的東西，或具有強烈的佔有欲。","entries":[{"sentence":"Sarah felt <target>envious</target> <pattern>of</pattern> her classmate's ability to speak three languages fluently, which inspired her to study harder.","translation":"莎拉嫉妒她同學能流利地說三種語言的能力，這激勵她更加努力學習。","explanation":"形容詞「嫉妒的」。常用搭配：envious of (嫉妒...)。"},{"sentence":"Many students are <target>envious</target> <pattern>of</pattern> those who won the first prize in the science competition and received a full scholarship.","translation":"許多學生嫉妒那些在科學競賽中獲得一等獎並獲得全額獎學金的人。","explanation":"形容詞「嫉妒的」。常用搭配：envious of (嫉妒...)。"}],"related_forms":["envy"]}

{"headword":"envision","explanation":"動詞，意為「想像」或「展望」。常用於描述對未來可能發生的事情或理想狀態的視覺化想像。常考搭配為 envision something (想像某事) 或 envision doing something (想像做某事)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city planners <target>envision</target> a future where all public transportation is powered by clean energy to reduce pollution in the city center.","translation":"城市規劃者展望一個所有公共交通都由清潔能源驅動的未來，以減少市中心的污染。","explanation":"動詞「展望、想像」。指對未來的想像。"},{"sentence":"The principal <target>envisioned</target> <pattern>the school</pattern> <pattern>as</pattern> a hub of creativity and innovation, encouraging students to pursue their passions.","translation":"校長將學校想像成一個創意與創新的中心，鼓勵學生追求他們的熱情。","explanation":"動詞「想像」。常用搭配：envision something as something (將某事想像成...)。"}],"related_forms":["envisioned","envisioning"]}

{"headword":"epidemic","explanation":"名詞意為「流行病」；形容詞意為「流行的、普遍的」。名詞用法指短時間內在特定地區爆發的疾病。形容詞用法則可指疾病或某种不良行為的普遍化。注意與 pandemic (全球大流行) 的區別：epidemic 指的是局部區域的爆發。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government implemented strict quarantine measures to prevent the <target>epidemic</target> <pattern>from</pattern> spreading further across the province.","translation":"政府實施了嚴格的隔離措施，以防止流行病在省內進一步傳播。","explanation":"名詞「流行病」。常用搭配：prevent something from doing (防止某事發生)。"},{"sentence":"Medical experts are concerned about the <target>epidemic</target> <pattern>of</pattern> obesity among teenagers, which is linked to poor diet and lack of exercise.","translation":"醫學專家對青少年中肥胖的流行感到擔憂，這與不良的飲食和缺乏運動有關。","explanation":"名詞「流行病/普遍現象」。常用搭配：epidemic of (某種流行病/現象)。"},{"sentence":"The health department issued a warning about an <target>epidemic</target> disease that has affected thousands of people in the neighboring city.","translation":"衛生部門針對一種在鄰近城市影響了數千人的流行病發出了警告。","explanation":"形容詞「流行的、普遍的」。指疾病的傳播。"}],"related_forms":["epidemic","epidemics"]}

{"headword":"episode","explanation":"名詞，意為「集數」或「片段」。常用於指電視節目的一集，或人生中發生的一次特定事件（通常是不太愉快或尷尬的事件）。","entries":[{"sentence":"I missed the latest <target>episode</target> of my favorite TV show, so I had to watch the recording the next morning.","translation":"我錯過了我最喜歡的電視節目的一集，由於這個原因，我不得不在第二天早上看錄影。","explanation":"名詞「集數」。指電視節目的一集。"},{"sentence":"The sudden argument between the two friends was an embarrassing <target>episode</target> in their long-term friendship, but they eventually made up.","translation":"這兩個朋友之間突然的爭吵是他們長期友誼中一次尷尬的片段/事件。","explanation":"名詞「片段、事件」。指人生或歷史中發生的一次特定事件。"}],"related_forms":["episodes"]}

{"headword":"equation","explanation":"名詞，意為「方程式」或「權衡因素」。在數學中指等式；在比喻義中，指一個複雜的情況中需要考慮的因素。常考搭配為 balance the equation (平衡方程式/權衡因素)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The mathematics teacher asked the students to <target>solve</target> the <target>equation</target> using the formula they had learned in the previous lesson.","translation":"數學老師要求學生使用他們在前一課學過的公式來解這個方程式。","explanation":"名詞「方程式」。常用搭配：solve an equation (解方程式)。"},{"sentence":"When choosing a college, students must consider both academic reputation and tuition fees, as these two factors change the <target>equation</target> entirely.","translation":"在選擇大學時，學生必須考慮學術聲譽和學費，因為這兩個因素完全改變了權衡因素（情況）。","explanation":"名詞「權衡因素」。指在複雜情況中需要考慮的因素。"}],"related_forms":["equations"]}

{"headword":"equity","explanation":"名詞，意為「公平」或「資產淨值」。在 GSAT 中，常指代社會公平（與 equality 指的是同一標準的給予而 equity 側重於根據需求給予以達到公平）。在財務方面，指代公司股票或房屋的資產淨值。","entries":[{"sentence":"The school board is working to promote social <target>equity</target> by providing more resources to students from low-income families.","translation":"學校董事會正致力於促進社會公平，為來自低收入家庭的學生提供更多資源。","explanation":"名詞「公平」。側重於根據個體需求提供資源以達成公平。"},{"sentence":"After paying off the mortgage on her house, she had built up significant <target>equity</target> in the property, which she could use as a loan.","translation":"在還清房屋抵押貸款後，她在房產中積累了顯著的資產淨值，可以用來申請貸款。","explanation":"名詞「資產淨值」。指房產或投資的實際價值。"}],"related_forms":["equitable"]}

{"headword":"equivalent","explanation":"形容詞意為「等同的、相等的」；名詞意為「等值物」。常考搭配為 be equivalent to (等同於...)。注意與 equal 的區別：equal 指的是數量、大小或價值完全相同；而 equivalent 指的是在功能、價值或價值上具有相同效果或意義。","entries":[{"sentence":"Eight kilometers is roughly <target>equivalent</target> <pattern>to</pattern> five miles, so you can use either measurement depending on the country you are in.","translation":"八公里大約等同於五英里，所以你可以根據你所在的國家使用其中一種測量方式。","explanation":"形容詞「等同的」。常用搭配：be equivalent to (等同於...)。"},{"sentence":"The online course is considered <target>equivalent</target> <pattern>to</pattern> a traditional classroom lecture in terms of the knowledge it provides.","translation":"這個線上課程在提供知識方面被認為與傳統的課堂教學等同。","explanation":"形容詞「等同於」。指功能或效果相同。"},{"sentence":"The teacher provided a Chinese <target>equivalent</target> <pattern>for</pattern> the difficult English word, helping the students understand the meaning more quickly.","translation":"老師為這個困難的英文單字提供了一個中文等值詞，或說對應詞，幫助學生快速理解其含義。","explanation":"名詞「等值物、對應詞」。常用搭配：equivalent for (某個詞的對應詞)。"}],"related_forms":["equivalently","equivalence"]}

{"headword":"erect","explanation":"erect 可作動詞或形容詞。動詞指「建立、豎立」，常用於建築物或紀念碑；形容詞指「直立的」。注意動詞搭配，如 erect a statue (豎立雕像)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The city council decided to <target>erect</target> a large bronze statue <pattern>in</pattern> the center of the park to honor the local hero.","translation":"市議會決定在公園中心豎立一座大型青銅雕像，以紀念當地英雄。","explanation":"動詞「豎立」。常用搭配：erect a statue/monument (豎立雕像/紀念碑)。"},{"sentence":"To improve the camping experience, the scouts learned how to <target>erect</target> a tent quickly and securely before the rain started.","translation":"為了提升露營體驗，童軍們學習如何在下雨前快速且牢固地搭建帳篷。","explanation":"動詞「建立、搭建」。"},{"sentence":"The soldier stood <target>erect</target> during the national anthem, showing respect and discipline with his straight back.","translation":"士兵在國歌演奏期間直立而立，挺直背部，展現出尊重與紀律。","explanation":"形容詞「直立的」。"}],"related_forms":["erection"]}

{"headword":"errand","explanation":"名詞「跑腿的事、雜務」。通常指為了某個目的而短距離出行的任務，常用片語 run an errand (跑腿)。","entries":[{"sentence":"My mother asked me to <pattern>run</pattern> a quick <target>errand</target> for her, such as picking up some groceries from the nearby supermarket.","translation":"我母親請我幫她跑個腿，比如去附近的超市買一些雜貨。","explanation":"名詞「跑腿的事」。常用片語 run an errand (跑腿)。"},{"sentence":"After finishing his homework, the student spent an hour <pattern>running</pattern> <target>errands</target> around town to prepare for the school festival.","translation":"完成作業後，該學生花了一小時在鎮上跑腿，為學校祭典做準備。","explanation":"名詞「雜務」。此處為複數形式 errands。"}],"related_forms":["errands"]}

{"headword":"erupt","explanation":"動詞「爆發」。常用於火山爆發 (volcano erupts) 或情緒、衝突的突然爆發。注意其名詞形式 eruption (爆發)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The residents were evacuated immediately after the volcano <target>erupted</target>, sending thick clouds of ash into the sky.","translation":"火山爆發後，居民立即被撤離，濃厚的火山灰雲湧入天空。","explanation":"動詞「爆發」。常用於自然現象如火山爆發。"},{"sentence":"Violence <target>erupted</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the streets after the controversial decision was announced, as people expressed their anger and frustration.","translation":"在爭議性決定公布後，街道上爆發了暴力事件，人們表達他們的憤怒與挫折感。","explanation":"動詞「爆發」。常用於描述衝突、爭議或情緒的突然爆發。"}],"related_forms":["eruption"]}

{"headword":"escalator","explanation":"名詞「電扶梯」。常用於商場、機場或車站等公共場所。","entries":[{"sentence":"Because the elevator was broken, the shoppers had to take the <target>escalator</target> to reach the third floor of the mall.","translation":"因為電梯壞了，購物者必須乘坐電扶梯到達商場的三樓。","explanation":"名詞「電扶梯」。"},{"sentence":"Please stand <pattern>on</pattern> the right side of the <target>escalator</target> to allow other people to pass through quickly.","translation":"請站在電扶梯的右側，以允許其他人快速通過。","explanation":"名詞「電扶梯」。常用搭配 stand on the escalator。"}],"related_forms":["escalators"]}

{"headword":"essence","explanation":"名詞「本質、精髓」或「精油」。在 GSAT 中，最常考的是指某事物的核心本質。常用片語 in essence (本質上)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>essence</target> <pattern>of</pattern> democracy is the belief that every citizen should have an equal voice in how the target country is governed.","translation":"民主的本質是相信每位公民在國家治理方式上應有平等的發言權。","explanation":"名詞「本質」。常用搭配 essence of sth。"},{"sentence":"Although the two theories seem different, they are <pattern>in</pattern> <target>essence</target> the same, as both emphasize the importance of hard work.","translation":"雖然這兩個理論看起來不同，但本質上是一樣的，因為兩者都強調努力的重要性。","explanation":"名詞「本質」。片語 in essence 表示「本質上」。"},{"sentence":"The bakery uses a small amount of vanilla <target>essence</target> to give the cake a sweet and fragrant aroma.","translation":"麵包店使用少量的香草精油，賦予蛋糕甜美且芳香的氣味。","explanation":"名詞「精油、萃取物」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"estate","explanation":"名詞「地產、房產」或「遺產」。常用搭配 real estate (房地產) 或 the estate of (某人的遺產)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many young couples find it difficult to buy <pattern>real</pattern> <target>estate</target> in the city because the house prices are too high.","translation":"許多年輕夫婦發現很難在城市購買房地產，因為房價太高。","explanation":"名詞「房地產」。常用搭配 real estate。"},{"sentence":"After the wealthy businessman passed away, his lawyers spent months managing his vast <target>estate</target> and distributing the money to his children.","translation":"這位富有的商人去世後，他的律師花了好幾個月管理他的龐大遺產並將錢分給他的孩子。","explanation":"名詞「遺產」。指去世者留下的所有財產。"}],"related_forms":["estates"]}

{"headword":"eternal","explanation":"形容詞「永恆的、永久的」。常用於描述時間或情感，如 eternal love (永恆的愛) 或 eternal life (永恆的生命)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The poet wrote a beautiful song about <target>eternal</target> <pattern>love</pattern>, describing a feeling that never ends even after death.","translation":"詩人寫了一首關於永恆之愛的優美歌曲，描述一種即使在死亡後也不會結束的感覺。","explanation":"形容詞「永恆的」。常用搭配 eternal love。"},{"sentence":"Some religions believe in <target>eternal</target> <pattern>life</pattern> in heaven, where people can live forever without any pain or suffering.","translation":"某些宗教相信天堂有永恆的生命，人們可以在那裡永遠生活，沒有任何痛苦或折磨。","explanation":"形容詞「永恆的」。常用搭配 eternal life。"}],"related_forms":["eternally","eternity"]}

{"headword":"ethic","explanation":"名詞，通常以複數形式 ethics 出現，指「倫理、道德準則」。常用搭配 work ethic (工作倫理/態度)。注意與 ethical (形容詞) 的區別。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company values a strong <pattern>work</pattern> <target>ethic</target>, expecting employees to be punctual and dedicated to their daily tasks.","translation":"公司重視強烈的工作倫理，期望員工準時且致力於其日常任務。","explanation":"名詞「工作倫理」。常用搭配 work ethic。"},{"sentence":"Medical <target>ethics</target> provide a set of guidelines for doctors to ensure that patients are treated with dignity and respect.","translation":"醫療倫理為醫生提供了一套指南，以確保患者在受尊重且有尊嚴地被對待。","explanation":"名詞「倫理、道德準則」。ethics 常指一個學科或一套準則。"}],"related_forms":["ethical"]}

{"headword":"ethical","explanation":"形容詞「合乎道德的」。常與 unethical (不合道德的) 相對。常用於討論商業或科學實驗的道德問題。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many consumers prefer to buy products from <target>ethical</target> <pattern>companies</pattern> that treat their workers fairly and protect the environment.","translation":"許多消費者偏好從合乎道德的公司購買產品，那些公司公平對待工人並保護環境。","explanation":"形容詞「合乎道德的」。常用搭配 ethical companies。"},{"sentence":"Scientists must follow <target>ethical</target> <pattern>guidelines</pattern> when conducting experiments on animals to prevent unnecessary suffering.","translation":"科學家在對動物進行實驗時必須遵循道德指南，以防止不必要的痛苦。","explanation":"形容詞「合乎道德的」。常用搭配 ethical guidelines。"}],"related_forms":["ethically","ethics"]}

{"headword":"evolution","explanation":"名詞「進化、演變」。常用於生物學（物種進化）或描述某事物的逐漸發展過程。常用搭配 the evolution of (…的演變)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Charles Darwin is famous for his theory of <target>evolution</target>, which explains how species change over time to survive in their environment.","translation":"查爾斯·達爾文以其進化論聞名，解釋了物種如何隨時間改變以在環境中生存。","explanation":"名詞「進化」。指生物物種的演變。"},{"sentence":"The <target>evolution</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the smartphone has completely changed the way people communicate and access information in their daily lives.","translation":"智慧型手機的演變完全改變了人們在日常生活中溝通和獲取資訊的方式。","explanation":"名詞「演變」。指事物逐漸發展的過程。"}],"related_forms":["evolve","evolutionary"]}

{"headword":"evolve","explanation":"動詞「進化、演變」。指事物隨著時間緩慢地改變，以適應新環境或變得更複雜。常用搭配 evolve from (從...演變而來) 或 evolve into (演變成為)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Scientists believe that birds <target>evolved</target> <pattern>from</pattern> small dinosaurs millions of years ago to survive in changing environments.","translation":"科學家相信鳥類是在數百萬年前從小型恐龍演變而來的，以在不斷變化的環境中生存。","explanation":"動詞「演變」。常用搭配 evolve from (從...演變而來)。"},{"sentence":"The small family business <target>evolved</target> <pattern>into</pattern> a global corporation over several decades through hard work and innovation.","translation":"這家小型家族企業經過數十年的努力和創新，演變成為一家全球公司。","explanation":"動詞「演變」。常用搭配 evolve into (演變成為)。"},{"sentence":"The way students learn has <target>evolved</target> significantly <pattern>with</pattern> the introduction of digital tablets and online learning platforms.","translation":"隨著數位平板電腦和線上學習平台的引入，學生的學習方式發生了顯著的演變。","explanation":"動詞「演變」。描述事物隨著技術進步而改變。"}],"related_forms":["evolution","evolved"]}

{"headword":"exaggeration","explanation":"名詞「誇張」。指將事實描述得比實際情況更嚴重、更好或更大。常用搭配 an exaggeration (一個誇張之處)。","entries":[{"sentence":"It is no <target>exaggeration</target> to say that the internet has completely changed the way people communicate and access information.","translation":"說網路完全改變了人們溝通和獲取資訊的方式並非誇張。","explanation":"名詞「誇張」。片語 it is no exaggeration to say that... 表示「說...一點也不誇張」。"},{"sentence":"The witness's description of the thief was an <target>exaggeration</target>, as the suspect was actually much shorter than described.","translation":"證人對小偷的描述是一種誇張，因為嫌疑犯實際上比描述的要矮得多。","explanation":"名詞「誇張」。指描述與事實不符的情況。"}],"related_forms":["exaggerate"]}

{"headword":"exceed","explanation":"動詞「超過」。常用於數量、限度或期望。常搭配 exceed the limit (超過限制) 或 exceed expectations (超出預期)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Drivers who <target>exceed</target> the <pattern>speed limit</pattern> on the highway may face heavy fines or lose their driver's licenses.","translation":"在高速公路上超速的駕駛者可能會面臨高額罰款或被吊銷駕照。","explanation":"動詞「超過」。常用搭配 exceed the speed limit (超速)。"},{"sentence":"The student's final project <target>exceeded</target> all <pattern>expectations</pattern>, earning him the highest grade in the entire class.","translation":"該學生的期末專題報告超出了所有預期，為他贏得了全班最高分。","explanation":"動詞「超過」。常用搭配 exceed expectations (超出預期)。"},{"sentence":"The total cost of the renovation <target>exceeded</target> the original <pattern>budget</pattern>, forcing the family to find additional funds.","translation":"裝修的總成本超過了最初的預算，迫使這家人尋找額外的資金。","explanation":"動詞「超過」。常用搭配 exceed the budget (超過預算)。"}],"related_forms":["excessive","excess"]}

{"headword":"exceptional","explanation":"形容詞「卓越的，非凡的」。指遠高於平均水準的。常用搭配 an exceptional talent (卓越的天賦)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young pianist showed <target>exceptional</target> <pattern>talent</pattern> from a very early age, winning several international competitions.","translation":"這名年輕的鋼琴家從很小年紀就展現出卓越的天賦，贏得了數場國際比賽。","explanation":"形容詞「卓越的」。常用搭配 exceptional talent (卓越的天賦)。"},{"sentence":"Due to <target>exceptional</target> <pattern>circumstances</pattern>, the principal decided to postpone the school's graduation ceremony by one week.","translation":"由於特殊情況，校長決定將學校的畢業典禮延後一週。","explanation":"形容詞「特殊的，非凡的」。常用搭配 exceptional circumstances (特殊情況)。"},{"sentence":"The hotel provided <target>exceptional</target> <pattern>service</pattern>, making all the guests feel welcomed and comfortable during their stay.","translation":"飯店提供了卓越的服務，讓所有客人在入住期間感到受歡迎且舒適。","explanation":"形容詞「卓越的」。常用搭配 exceptional service (卓越的服務)。"}],"related_forms":["exception","exceptionally"]}

{"headword":"excessive","explanation":"形容詞「過度的，過多的」。指超過了適當的量或程度，通常帶有負面含義。常用搭配 excessive noise (過度的噪音) 或 excessive drinking (過度飲酒)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher warned the students that <target>excessive</target> <pattern>use</pattern> of smartphones in class would lead to a lower grade.","translation":"老師警告學生，在課堂上過度使用手機會導致成績下降。","explanation":"形容詞「過度的」。常用搭配 excessive use of sth (過度使用某物)。"},{"sentence":"The government implemented new laws to prevent <target>excessive</target> <pattern>pricing</pattern> of basic food items during the natural disaster.","translation":"政府實施了新法律，以防止在自然災害期間基本食品價格過高。","explanation":"形容詞「過度的」。指價格高得不合理。"},{"sentence":"Doctors advise that <target>excessive</target> <pattern>consumption</pattern> of sugar can increase the risk of developing diabetes and obesity.","translation":"醫生建議，過量攝取糖分會增加患糖尿病和肥胖症的風險。","explanation":"形容詞「過量的」。常用搭配 excessive consumption of sth (過量攝取某物)。"}],"related_forms":["excess","excessively"]}

{"headword":"exclaim","explanation":"動詞「驚嘆，大聲喊出」。指由於驚訝、憤怒或興奮而突然大聲說出。常用搭配 exclaim in surprise (驚訝地驚嘆)。","entries":[{"sentence":"\"Wow, this is the most beautiful view I have ever seen!\" <target>exclaimed</target> the hiker <pattern>in surprise</pattern> as he reached the peak.","translation":"「哇，這是我見過最美的風景！」登山客到達山頂時驚訝地驚嘆道。","explanation":"動詞「驚嘆」。常用搭配 exclaim in surprise (驚訝地驚嘆)。"},{"sentence":"When the student finally solved the difficult math problem, he <target>exclaimed</target> <pattern>with joy</pattern> that he had finally found the answer.","translation":"當學生終於解決了那個困難的數學題時，他興奮地大聲喊道，他終於找到了答案。","explanation":"動詞「驚嘆」。常用搭配 exclaim with joy (興奮地大聲喊出)。"}],"related_forms":["exclamation"]}

{"headword":"exclude","explanation":"動詞「排除，不包括」。指刻意地不讓某人或某物進入、參與或成為一部分。常用搭配 exclude from (將...排除在...之外)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The club's rules <target>exclude</target> anyone <pattern>from</pattern> joining if they do not have a recommendation letter from a current member.","translation":"該俱樂部的規定將任何沒有現任成員推薦信的人排除在加入之外。","explanation":"動詞「排除」。常用搭配 exclude from (將...排除在...之外)。"},{"sentence":"When calculating the average score, the teacher decided to <target>exclude</target> the lowest grade <pattern>of</pattern> each student to be fair.","translation":" ","explanation":"在計算平均分時，老師決定不包括每位學生的最低分，以示公平。"},{"sentence":"The high cost of the tour package <target>excluded</target> many students <pattern>from</pattern> participating in the overseas study trip.","translation":"旅遊套裝行程的高昂費用將許多學生排除在海外學習旅行之外。","explanation":"動詞「排除」。常用搭配 exclude from (將...排除在...之外)。"}],"related_forms":["exclusive","exclusion"]}

{"headword":"exclusive","explanation":"形容詞「獨有的，專屬的」。指僅限於某個特定群體或個體。常用搭配 exclusive interview (獨家採訪) 或 exclusive right (獨家權利)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The magazine secured an <target>exclusive</target> <pattern>interview</pattern> with the famous actor, which caused a huge increase in sales.","translation":"該雜誌獲得了這位著名演員的獨家採訪，導致銷售量大幅增加。","explanation":"形容詞「獨家的」。常用搭配 exclusive interview (獨家採訪)。"},{"sentence":"The luxury hotel has an <target>exclusive</target> <pattern>membership</pattern> that allows guests to access the private beach and special lounge.","translation":"這家豪華飯店擁有一項專屬會員制，允許客人在私人海灘和特別休息室中使用。","explanation":"形容詞「專屬的」。常用搭配 exclusive membership (專屬會員制)。"},{"sentence":"The company holds the <target>exclusive</target> <pattern>right</pattern> to sell these high-tech products in the Asian market for the next five years.","translation":" ","explanation":"該公司持有在未來五年內於亞洲市場銷售這些高科技產品的獨家權利。"}],"related_forms":["exclusively","exclusion"]}

{"headword":"execute","explanation":"動詞「執行，執行」。指將計畫、命令或任務完成。另有「處決」之意。常用搭配 execute a plan (執行計畫)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The team worked together to <target>execute</target> a complex <pattern>plan</pattern> to surprise their teacher for her birthday party.","translation":"團隊共同努力地執行了一個複雜的計畫，為了在老師的生日派對上給她驚喜。","explanation":"動詞「執行」。常用搭配 execute a plan (執行計畫)。"},{"sentence":"The software developer had to <target>execute</target> the <pattern>program</pattern> several times to ensure there were no bugs in the system.","translation":"軟體開發者必須執行該程式數次，以確保系統中沒有錯誤。","explanation":"動詞「執行」。指電腦程式的運行。"},{"sentence":"In the past, many criminals were <target>executed</target> <pattern>by</pattern> hanging, a practice that is now banned in most modern countries.","translation":" ","explanation":"在過去，許多罪犯被處決，方式是吊死，這種做法在大多數現代國家已被禁止。"}],"related_forms":["execution","executable"]}

{"headword":"execution","explanation":"名詞「執行，處決」。指計畫或任務的完成過程，或指將某人處死。常用搭配 the execution of a plan (計畫的執行)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Although the idea for the school project was brilliant, the <target>execution</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the plan was poor, leading to a disappointing result.","translation":"雖然學校專題的構思很出色，但計畫的執行過程很差，導致結果令人失望。","explanation":"名詞「執行」。常用搭配 the execution of sth (某事的執行)。"},{"sentence":"The artist's <target>execution</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the painting was flawless, showing his ability to handle colors and light perfectly.","translation":" ","explanation":"藝術家的繪畫執行力（技巧）完美無瑕，展現了他處理顏色和光線的完美能力。"}],"related_forms":["execute"]}

{"headword":"executive","explanation":"形容詞「行政的、管理上的」；名詞「行政主管、高級管理人員」。在商務或政治語境中， executive 通常指具有決策權的高層人員。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company's chief <target>executive</target> decided to implement a new marketing strategy to increase sales in the international market.","translation":"公司的首席執行官決定實施一套新的行銷策略，以增加在國際市場上的銷售額。","explanation":"名詞「高級管理人員」。chief executive 意為「首席執行官」。"},{"sentence":"The board of directors met with several top <target>executives</target> to discuss the long-term goals and financial budget for the next fiscal year.","translation":"董事會與幾位高階主管會面，討論下一財政年度的長期目標和財務預算。","explanation":"名詞「高級管理人員」。"},{"sentence":"The president of the country is the head of the <target>executive</target> <pattern>branch</pattern> of the government, responsible for enforcing laws and managing national affairs.","translation":"國家的總統是政府行政部門的首腦，負責執行法律並管理國家事務。","explanation":"形容詞「行政的」。常用搭配 executive branch (行政部門)。"}],"related_forms":["executively"]}

{"headword":"exile","explanation":"名詞「流亡、流亡者」；動詞「將...驅逐出境、流亡」。指被迫離開自己的國家或家鄉。常考搭配：in exile (在流亡中), go into exile (開始流亡)。","entries":[{"sentence":"After the political revolution, the former leader was forced to live <target>in</target> <pattern>exile</pattern> for many years in a neighboring country.","translation":"政治革命後，前領導人被迫在鄰國流亡多年。","explanation":"名詞「流亡」。片語 in exile 表示「在流亡狀態中」。"},{"sentence":"The young writer spent a decade <target>in</target> <pattern>exile</pattern>, writing books about his homeland and longing for the day he could return.","translation":"這位年輕的作家花十年時間流亡，寫關於故鄉的書，渴望著能回去的那一天。","explanation":"名詞「流亡」。"},{"sentence":"The government decided to <target>exile</target> the rebel leader <pattern>to</pattern> a remote island to prevent him from influencing the people further.","translation":"政府決定將反叛領袖驅逐到一座偏遠的島嶼，以防止他進一步影響民眾。","explanation":"動詞「將...驅逐出境」。常用搭配 exile someone to somewhere。"}],"related_forms":["exiled"]}

{"headword":"exotic","explanation":"形容詞「異國風情的、外來的」；名詞「外來物種」。常用於描述來自遙遠國家的事物，帶有新奇或吸引人的色彩。常見搭配：exotic plants, exotic animals, exotic locations。","entries":[{"sentence":"The botanical garden features a wide variety of <target>exotic</target> <pattern>plants</pattern> brought from the tropical rainforests of South America.","translation":"植物園展示了來自南美洲熱帶雨林的各種異國植物。","explanation":"形容詞「異國風情的」。常用搭配 exotic plants (異國植物)。"},{"sentence":"Many travelers are drawn to the island because of its <target>exotic</target> <pattern>beaches</pattern> and unique cultural traditions that differ from their own.","translation":"許多旅行者被這座島吸引，是因為它擁有異國風情的沙灘和與自身截然不同的獨特文化傳統。","explanation":"形容詞「異國風情的」。"},{"sentence":"The introduction of <target>exotic</target> <pattern>species</pattern> into the local ecosystem can sometimes lead to the loss of native plants and animals.","translation":"將外來物種引入當地生態系統有時會導致本土植物和動物的流失。","explanation":"形容詞/名詞「外來物種」。exotic species 指的是非本土的物種。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"expedition","explanation":"名詞「遠征、探險」。指為了特定目的（如科學研究或地理發現）而進行的有組織的旅程。常用搭配：go on an expedition, lead an expedition。","entries":[{"sentence":"The scientist led a daring <target>expedition</target> <pattern>to</pattern> the North Pole to study the effects of climate change on the Arctic ice caps.","translation":"這位科學家率領一次大膽的探險前往北極，以研究氣候變遷對北極冰帽的影響。","explanation":"名詞「探險」。常用搭配 expedition to somewhere。"},{"sentence":"After months of preparation, the team of archaeologists embarked on an <target>expedition</target> to discover the lost city in the jungle.","translation":"經過數月的準備，考古學家團隊開始了一次探險，以發現叢林中的失落之城。","explanation":"名詞「探險」。embark on an expedition 表示「開始一次探險」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"expertise","explanation":"名詞「專業知識、專長」。指在特定領域中經過長期練習或學習而獲得的高深知識或技能。常用搭配：expertise in sth, possess expertise in sth。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company is looking for a software engineer who possesses deep <target>expertise</target> <pattern>in</pattern> artificial intelligence and machine learning.","translation":"公司正在尋找一位在人工智慧和機器學習方面擁有深厚專業知識的軟體工程師。","explanation":"名詞「專業知識」。常用搭配 expertise in sth。"},{"sentence":"The professor's <target>expertise</target> <pattern>in</pattern> ancient Greek history made him the perfect candidate to lead the university's new research project.","translation":"這位教授在古希臘歷史方面的專業知識使他成為領導大學新研究計畫的最佳人選。","explanation":"名詞「專業知識」。"}],"related_forms":["expert"]}

{"headword":"explicit","explanation":"形容詞「明確的、詳盡的」。指表達方式直接且清晰，不含糊。注意與 implicit (含蓄的) 相反。常用搭配：explicit instructions, explicit agreement。","entries":[{"sentence":"The teacher gave <target>explicit</target> <pattern>instructions</pattern> on how to format the final essay, so the students knew exactly what was expected.","translation":"老師針對期末論文的格式給予了明確的指令，因此學生們清楚知道被期待的是什麼。","explanation":"形容詞「明確的」。常用搭配 explicit instructions (明確的指令)。"},{"sentence":"Although the two countries had a verbal agreement, they decided to sign an <target>explicit</target> <pattern>contract</pattern> to avoid any future misunderstandings.","translation":"儘管兩國有口頭協議，但他們決定簽署一份明確的合約，以避免未來的任何誤會。","explanation":"形容詞「明確的」。常用搭配 explicit contract (明確的合約)。"}],"related_forms":["explicitly"]}

{"headword":"exploit","explanation":"動詞「利用、開發；剝削」；名詞「功績、壯舉」。動詞用法中，利用 (use) 與剝削 (exploit) 的涵義不同，前者指開發資源，後者指不公平地利用他人。常見搭配：exploit resources, exploit workers。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new company developed a way to <target>exploit</target> solar energy more efficiently, providing cheaper electricity to thousands of homes.","translation":"這家新公司開發出了一種更有效地利用太陽能的方法，為數千個家庭提供更便宜的電力。","explanation":"動詞「利用、開發」。指將資源轉化為有用之處。"},{"sentence":"Many human rights organizations criticize companies that <target>exploit</target> <pattern>child labor</pattern> in developing countries to reduce production costs.","translation":"許多人權組織批評那些在開發中國家剝削童工以降低生產成本的公司。","explanation":"動詞「剝削」。指不公平地利用他人獲利。"},{"sentence":"The old sailor entertained the children with stories of his daring <target>exploits</target> while traveling across the seven seas.","translation":"老水手用他航行七海時的大膽壯舉來娛樂孩子們。","explanation":"名詞「壯舉、功績」。指勇敢或不尋常的行動。"}],"related_forms":["exploitation","exploitative"]}

{"headword":"exploration","explanation":"名詞「探索、探險」。指對未知地區或未知事物的詳細研究或調查。常用搭配：exploration of sth, space exploration。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>exploration</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the deep ocean remains one of the greatest challenges for modern science due to the extreme pressure.","translation":"由於極端的壓力，深海探索仍然是現代科學最大的挑戰之一。","explanation":"名詞「探索」。常用搭配 exploration of sth。"},{"sentence":"The government invested billions of dollars in space <target>exploration</target> to discover whether other planets can support human life.","translation":"政府投資了數十億美元用於太空探索，以發現其他行星是否能支持人類生存。","explanation":"名詞「探索」。space exploration 意為「太空探索」。"}],"related_forms":["explore","exploratory"]}

{"headword":"extension","explanation":"名詞「延伸、擴展；延期」。常用於指空間的增加、時間的延長或電話的分機。常考搭配：extension of the deadline, extension cord。","entries":[{"sentence":"The student asked the professor for an <target>extension</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the deadline for the final project because he was sick for a week.","translation":"由於生病一週，該學生請求教授延長期末計畫的截止日期。","explanation":"名詞「延期」。常用搭配 extension of the deadline (延期截止日)。"},{"sentence":"The city council decided to build an <target>extension</target> to the local library to provide more space for study rooms and bookshelves.","translation":"市議會決定為當地圖書館建造一個擴建部分，以提供更多研習室和書架空間。","explanation":"名詞「延伸、擴展」。指空間上的增加。"},{"sentence":"Since the power outlet was too far from the desk, she had to use an <target>extension</target> <pattern>cord</pattern> to plug in her laptop.","translation":"由於電源插座距離書桌太遠，她必須使用延長線來接上她的筆記型電腦。","explanation":"名詞「延伸」。extension cord 意為「延長線」。"}],"related_forms":["extend","extensive"]}

{"headword":"extensive","explanation":"形容詞「廣泛的、 extensive 」。指範圍大或程度深。常用搭配：extensive knowledge, extensive research, extensive damage。","entries":[{"sentence":"The historian conducted <target>extensive</target> <pattern>research</pattern> on the ancient civilization, spending years visiting various museums and libraries.","translation":"這位歷史學家對該古代文明進行了廣泛的研究，花了數年時間訪問各種博物館和圖書館。","explanation":"形容詞「廣泛的」。常用搭配 extensive research (廣泛的研究)。"},{"sentence":"The storm caused <target>extensive</target> <pattern>damage</pattern> to the coastal villages, destroying many homes and forcing thousands of people to evacuate.","translation":"風暴對沿海村莊造成了廣泛的損害，摧毀了許多房屋並迫使數千人撤離。","explanation":"形容詞「廣泛的」。常用搭配 extensive damage (廣泛的損害)。"},{"sentence":"The new employee was hired because he had <target>extensive</target> <pattern>experience</pattern> in international trade and spoke four different languages fluently.","translation":"這位新員工被聘用是因為他在國際貿易方面有廣泛的經驗且能流利地說四種不同的語言。","explanation":"形容詞「廣泛的」。常用搭配 extensive experience (廣泛的經驗)。"}],"related_forms":["extend","extension"]}

{"headword":"exterior","explanation":"exterior 可作名詞或形容詞，主要指「外部」或「外表」。作為形容詞時，指物體的外側。作為名詞時，指建築物或物體的外部。常考對比是 interior (內部)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The designers decided to paint the <target>exterior</target> of the house a light grey to make it look more modern and clean.","translation":"設計師決定將房子的外牆塗成淺灰色，使其看起來更現代且乾淨。","explanation":"名詞用法，指建築物的外部面。"},{"sentence":"Although the <target>exterior</target> walls were old and weathered, the inside of the building had been completely renovated with new furniture.","translation":"雖然外牆陳舊且風化，但建築內部已用新家具完全翻新。","explanation":"形容詞用法，修飾 walls，表示「外部的」。"}],"related_forms":["exteriors"]}

{"headword":"external","explanation":"external 主要作為形容詞，指「外部的」或「外在的」。它常指從外部而來的影響或與外部環境相關的事物。在名詞用法中，較少見，通常指外部因素或外部部分。","entries":[{"sentence":"The company's failure was caused by <target>external</target> factors, such as the sudden economic crisis and the change in consumer preferences.","translation":"公司的失敗是由外部因素造成的，例如突然的經濟危機和消費者的偏好改變。","explanation":"形容詞用法，表示「外部的」，指不受內部控制的因素。"},{"sentence":"The doctor recommended using an <target>external</target> ointment to treat the skin rash, rather than taking medicine that affects the whole body.","translation":"醫生建議使用外用藥膏來治療皮疹，而不是服用影響全身的藥物。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指「外在的」，常用於醫學上表示外用。"},{"sentence":"To protect the computer's data, the user connected an <target>external</target> hard drive to save a backup of all important files.","translation":"為了保護電腦數據，使用者連接了一個外接硬碟來儲存所有重要文件的備份。","explanation":"形容詞用法，指「外接的、外部的」。"}],"related_forms":["externally"]}

{"headword":"extinct","explanation":"形容詞，意為「絕種的」或「死掉的」。常用於描述動物物種或古老的語言。常用搭配 extinct species (絕種物種)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Many scientists believe that dinosaurs became <target>extinct</target> millions of years ago after a giant asteroid hit the Earth.","translation":"許多科學家相信，在巨大的小行星撞擊地球後，恐龍在數百萬年前就絕種了。","explanation":"形容詞用法，表示「絕種的」。"},{"sentence":"Conservationists are working hard to protect the remaining wild tigers, preventing them from becoming <target>extinct</target> due to habitat loss.","translation":"保育人士正努力保護剩餘的野生老虎，防止它們因棲息地喪失而絕種。","explanation":"形容詞用法，表示「絕種的」。常用搭配 become extinct。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"extraordinary","explanation":"形容詞，意為「非凡的、異常的」。用來描述事物超出普通水準或常規。注意與 ordinary (普通的) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The young pianist showed <target>extraordinary</target> talent in music, winning several international competitions before the age of ten.","translation":"這位年輕的鋼琴家在音樂方面展現了非凡的才華，在十歲之前就贏得了多次國際比賽。","explanation":"形容詞用法，表示「非凡的、出色的」。"},{"sentence":"It was <target>extraordinary</target> that the student managed to finish the complex project on time despite having very little help.","translation":"令人驚訝的是，這位學生在幾乎沒有幫助的情況下，仍能按時完成這項複雜的計畫。","explanation":"形容詞用法，表示「異常的、令人驚訝的」。"}],"related_forms":["extraordinarily"]}

{"headword":"fabric","explanation":"名詞，指「布料」或「結構」。前者指紡織品，後者指社會或系統的組成方式（比喻用法）。","entries":[{"sentence":"The fashion designer chose a soft, breathable <target>fabric</target> for the summer dresses to ensure the customers stay cool.","translation":"時裝設計師為夏季連衣裙選擇了一種柔軟且透氣的布料，以確保顧客保持涼爽。","explanation":"名詞用法，指「布料」。"},{"sentence":"The sudden economic crash threatened to tear the social <target>fabric</target> of the small town, causing people to lose trust in each other.","translation":"突然的經濟崩潰威脅到這個小鎮的社會結構，導致人們失去對彼此的信任。","explanation":"名詞用法，指「結構」。social fabric 是常見的比喻用法。"}],"related_forms":["fabrics"]}

{"headword":"fabulous","explanation":"形容詞，意為「極好的」或「傳說中的」。在日常對話中，常用於表達強烈的讚美，相當於 wonderful 或 fantastic。","entries":[{"sentence":"The students had a <target>fabulous</target> time at the school beach party, enjoying the music, food, and the beautiful sunset.","translation":"學生們在學校的海邊派對上玩得非常開心，享受著音樂、食物和美麗的日落。","explanation":"形容事物的狀態，表示「極好的」。"},{"sentence":"She looked <target>fabulous</target> in her new red dress, which was a perfect match for the formal graduation ceremony.","translation":"她穿著新的紅裙子看起來非常漂亮，完美契合正式的畢業典禮。","explanation":"形容詞用法，表示「極好的、漂亮的」。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"facilitate","explanation":"動詞，意為「促進、使便利」。常用於描述使某個過程或行動更容易達成。常見搭配 facilitate the process (促進過程)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The new online registration system was designed to <target>facilitate</target> the enrollment process for new students and parents.","translation":"新的在線註冊系統旨在簡化新學生和家長的入學流程。","explanation":"動詞用法，表示「使便利、促進」。"},{"sentence":"The government provided subsidies to <target>facilitate</target> the transition to renewable energy, reducing the reliance on fossil fuels.","translation":"政府提供補貼以促進向可再生能源的轉型，減少對化石燃料的依賴。","explanation":"動詞用法，表示「促進」。"}],"related_forms":["facilitation","facilitator"]}

{"headword":"faculty","explanation":"名詞，可指「學院/教職員」或「能力」。在校園背景下，常指一所學校的全部教職員；在心理或生理背景下，指某種天賦或能力。","entries":[{"sentence":"The university <target>faculty</target> met to discuss the new curriculum changes, ensuring that the courses meet current academic standards.","translation":"大學教職員會議討論了新的課程變更，確保課程符合目前的學術標準。","explanation":"名詞用法，指「全體教職員」。"},{"sentence":"The school of law is the most prestigious <target>faculty</target> in the university, attracting many top students from around the world.","translation":"法學院是該大學中最負盛名的學院，吸引了來自世界各地的頂尖學生。","explanation":"名詞用法，指「學院」。"},{"sentence":"As he grew older, the old man slowly lost his mental <target>faculties</target>, making it difficult for him to remember names.","translation":"隨著年齡增長，這位老人逐漸失去了他的心智能力，使他很難記得名字。","explanation":"名詞用法，指「能力」。常用複數 faculties。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"fascinate","explanation":"動詞，意為「使著迷」。常用被動語態或形容詞形式 fascinate/fascinating/fascinated。注意搭配 be fascinated by (被...著迷)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The mysterious stories about ancient Egypt <target>fascinated</target> the young boy, leading him to spend hours reading history books.","translation":"關於古埃及的神秘故事讓這個小男孩著迷，使他花好幾個小時閱讀歷史書。","explanation":"主動用法，表示「使著迷」。"},{"sentence":"Many tourists are <target>fascinated</target> <pattern>by</pattern> the unique architecture of the city, taking hundreds of photos to capture its beauty.","translation":"許多遊客被這座城市獨特的建築所著迷，拍了數百張照片以捕捉其美感。","explanation":"被動用法，表示「對...著迷」。常用搭配 be fascinated by。"}],"related_forms":["fascinating","fascination"]}

{"headword":"fatigue","explanation":"fatigue 可作名詞或動詞。名詞指「極度疲勞」，通常指長期壓力或過度工作導致的疲憊。動詞則指「使疲憊」。","entries":[{"sentence":"After running a full marathon, the athlete felt extreme <target>fatigue</target>, needing several days of complete rest to recover.","translation":"跑完一場全馬後，運動員感到極度疲勞，需要好幾天完全休息才能恢復。","explanation":"名詞用法，指「極度疲勞」。"},{"sentence":"The long hours of studying for the final exams <target>fatigued</target> the students, making them lose focus during the lectures.","translation":"為了期末考而長時間的學習使學生們疲憊不堪，使他們在課堂上失去專注力。","explanation":"動詞用法，表示「使疲憊」。"},{"sentence":"Chronic <target>fatigue</target> can be a sign of serious health problems, so it is important to consult a doctor if symptoms persist.","translation":"慢性疲勞可能是嚴重健康問題的跡象，因此如果症狀持續，諮詢醫生是很重要的。","explanation":"名詞用法，指「慢性疲勞」。"}],"related_forms":["fatigued","fatiguing"]}

{"headword":"federal","explanation":"形容詞「聯邦的、中央政府的」。常用於描述與聯邦政府相關的法律、權力或系統，如 federal law (聯邦法律), federal government (聯邦政府)。注意與 state (州) 或 local (地方) 相對。","entries":[{"sentence":"The <target>federal</target> <pattern>government</pattern> implemented new policies to improve the quality of public education across all states in the country.","translation":"聯邦政府實施了新政策，以提高全國所有州的公共教育質量。","explanation":"形容詞「聯邦的」。常用搭配 federal government (聯邦政府)。"},{"sentence":"Because the crime happened across state lines, the <target>federal</target> <pattern>authorities</pattern> took over the investigation to ensure a thorough search.","translation":"由於這起犯罪跨越了州界，聯邦當局接管了調查以確保搜索徹底。","explanation":"形容詞「聯邦的」。常用搭配 federal authorities (聯邦當局)。"},{"sentence":"Students who qualify for <target>federal</target> <pattern>loans</pattern> may find it easier to pay for their university tuition than those using private loans.","translation":"符合聯邦貸款資格的學生可能會發現，支付大學學費比使用私人貸款更容易。","explanation":"形容詞「聯邦的」。常用搭配 federal loans (聯邦貸款)。"}],"related_forms":["federalism","federation"]}

{"headword":"fiber","explanation":"名詞「纖維」。可用於描述生物纖維（如肌肉纖維）、紡織纖維（如棉纖維）或飲食中的纖維質。常考搭配：dietary fiber (膳食纖維), carbon fiber (碳纖維)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Eating more vegetables and fruits is highly recommended because they are rich in dietary <target>fiber</target>, which helps maintain a healthy digestive system.","translation":"強烈建議多吃蔬菜和水果，因為它們富含膳食纖維，有助於維持健康的消化系統。","explanation":"名詞「纖維」。常用搭配 dietary fiber (膳食纖維)。"},{"sentence":"The new tennis racket is made of lightweight carbon <target>fiber</target>, making it much stronger and easier to swing than traditional materials.","translation":"這把新網球拍是由輕量碳纖維製成的，比傳統材料更強壯且更容易揮動。","explanation":"名詞「纖維」。常用搭配 carbon fiber (碳纖維)。"},{"sentence":"Under the microscope, the biologist could see the individual muscle <target>fibers</target> contracting and relaxing as the cell responded to the stimulus.","translation":"在顯微鏡下，生物學家可以看到肌肉纖維在細胞對刺激做出反應時收縮和舒張。","explanation":"名詞「纖維」。在此指生物學上的肌肉纖維。"}],"related_forms":["fibrous"]}

{"headword":"filter","explanation":"名詞「過濾器」；動詞「過濾」。名詞常用於水過濾器或社交媒體的濾鏡。動詞常用的搭配有 filter out (過濾掉/排除)。","entries":[{"sentence":"To ensure the drinking water is safe, the family installed a high-quality <target>filter</target> in their kitchen sink to remove harmful impurities.","translation":"為了確保飲用水安全，這家人在廚房水槽安裝了一個高品質的過濾器以去除有害雜質。","explanation":"名詞「過濾器」。指用來清除雜質的裝置。"},{"sentence":"Many teenagers enjoy using different <target>filters</target> on their photos to change the colors and make their images look more professional.","translation":"許多青少年喜歡在照片上使用不同的濾鏡，以改變顏色並使圖像看起來更專業。","explanation":"名詞「濾鏡」。指數位圖像處理中的效果。"},{"sentence":"The new software allows users to <target>filter</target> <pattern>out</pattern> unwanted emails, so they only receive messages from trusted contacts.","translation":"這款新軟體允許用戶過濾掉不想要的電子郵件，因此他們只會收到來自信任聯繫人的訊息。","explanation":"動詞片語 filter out 表示「過濾掉」或「排除」。"}],"related_forms":["filtration","filtered"]}

{"headword":"fiscal","explanation":"形容詞「財政的、會計的」。常用於描述政府的收入與支出，如 fiscal year (財政年度), fiscal policy (財政政策)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government announced a new <target>fiscal</target> <pattern>policy</pattern> to stimulate economic growth by reducing taxes for small and medium enterprises.","translation":"政府宣布了一項新的財政政策，旨在通過降低中小企業的稅收來刺激經濟增長。","explanation":"形容詞「財政的」。常用搭配 fiscal policy (財政政策)。"},{"sentence":"The company's annual report shows that they reached their financial goals before the end of the current <target>fiscal</target> <pattern>year</pattern>.","translation":"公司的年度報告顯示，他們在當前財政年度結束前達成了財務目標。","explanation":"形容詞「財政的」。常用搭配 fiscal year (財政年度)。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"fleet","explanation":"名詞「艦隊、機群、車隊」。指同一組織擁有的所有船隻、飛機或車輛。常用搭配：a fleet of (一群/一批...)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The navy deployed a powerful <target>fleet</target> of warships to the region to maintain peace and protect international shipping routes.","translation":"海軍向該地區部署了一支強大的戰艦艦隊，以維持和平並保護國際航運路線。","explanation":"名詞「艦隊」。指軍事用途的船隻群。"},{"sentence":"The delivery company expanded its <target>fleet</target> of electric vans to reduce carbon emissions and improve delivery efficiency in the city.","translation":"快遞公司擴展了其電動貨車車隊，以減少碳排放並提高城市內的配送效率。","explanation":"名詞「車隊」。指同一公司擁有的車輛群。"}],"related_forms":[]}

{"headword":"flexibility","explanation":"名詞「靈活性、彈性」。可用於描述身體的柔軟度，或工作、時間安排上的靈活性。常用搭配：have flexibility in (在...方面有彈性)。","entries":[{"sentence":"Yoga is an excellent way to increase physical <target>flexibility</target>, allowing athletes to move their bodies more freely and reduce the risk of injury.","translation":"瑜伽是增加身體靈活性的絕佳方式，讓運動員能更自由地移動身體並降低受傷風險。","explanation":"名詞「靈活性」。指身體的柔軟度。"},{"sentence":"Many employees prefer remote work because it offers more <target>flexibility</target> <pattern>in</pattern> their daily schedules, allowing them to balance work and family life.","translation":"許多員工偏好遠端工作，因為這為他們的日常時間表提供了更多靈活性，使他們能平衡工作與家庭生活。","explanation":"名詞「靈活性」。指時間或安排上的彈性。"}],"related_forms":["flexible"]}
