{"headword":"interior","explanation":"形容詞「內部的」；名詞「內部」。形容詞常用於描述建築、車輛或身體內部。名詞則可指一個空間的內部或一個國家的內陸地帶。","entries":[{"sentence":"The designer focused on the <target>interior</target> decorations of the house, choosing soft colors and modern furniture to create a relaxing atmosphere.","translation":"設計師專注於房子的內部裝飾，選擇柔和的顏色和現代家具以營造放鬆的氛圍。","explanation":"形容詞「內部的」。"},{"sentence":"The car's <target>interior</target> was made of high-quality leather, which made the vehicle feel much more luxurious and comfortable for the passengers.","translation":"這輛車的內部是由高品質皮革製成的，這使得乘客感到車輛更加豪華舒適。","explanation":"名詞「內部」。指車輛或建築的內部空間。"},{"sentence":"Early explorers faced many dangers when they traveled into the <target>interior</target> of the continent, as there were no maps for those regions.","translation":"早期的探險家在進入大陸內部（內陸）旅行時面臨許多危險，因為那些地區沒有地圖。","explanation":"名詞「內部/內陸」。指一個地理區域的中心地帶。"}],"related_forms":["interiorly"]}

{"headword":"interpretation","explanation":"名詞，意為「解釋」或「口譯」。指對某種意義的理解或對外語的即時翻譯。常用搭配：interpretation of (對...的解釋/理解)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The two historians had a different <target>interpretation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the ancient text, leading to a long debate about its true meaning.","translation":"兩位歷史學家對這篇古文有不同的解釋，導致關於其真正含義的長期爭論。","explanation":"名詞「解釋、理解」。指對資訊的解讀方式。"},{"sentence":"Since the diplomat did not speak the local language, he relied on the <target>interpretation</target> provided by his assistant during the meeting.","translation":"由於外交官不會說當地語言，他在會議期間依賴助手提供的口譯。","explanation":"名詞「口譯」。指將一種語言即時翻譯成另一種語言。"},{"sentence":"The actor's unique <target>interpretation</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the character made the play more interesting and gave the audience a new perspective.","translation":"這位演員對角色的獨特詮釋，使這齣戲變得更有趣，並給觀眾帶來了新的視角。","explanation":"名詞「詮釋」。指在藝術或表演中對角色的理解。"}],"related_forms":["interpret"]}

{"headword":"interval","explanation":"名詞，意為「間隔」或「間歇」。指時間或空間上的距離。常見搭配：at regular intervals (定期地/等距地), time interval (時間間隔)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The security guard walked around the building <pattern>at</pattern> <target>regular</target> <target>intervals</target> to ensure that all the doors were locked.","translation":"保全人員定期地在建築物周圍巡邏，以確保所有的門都鎖上了。","explanation":"名詞「間隔」。片語 at regular intervals 表示「定期地」或「等距地」。"},{"sentence":"During the long play, there was a fifteen-minute <target>interval</target> for the audience to stretch their legs and buy some drinks.","translation":"在長篇劇目中，有十五分鐘的間歇，讓觀眾伸展腿部並買些飲料。","explanation":"名詞「間歇」。指在活動中暫停的一段時間。"},{"sentence":"The scientist measured the <target>interval</target> <pattern>between</pattern> the two chemical reactions to determine how fast the process was happening.","translation":"科學家測量了兩次化學反應之間的時間間隔，以確定過程進行的速度有多快。","explanation":"名詞「間隔」。指兩個事件或物體之間的距離。"}],"related_forms":["intervals"]}

{"headword":"intervention","explanation":"名詞，意為「干預」或「介入」。通常指為了改善情況或防止惡化而採取行動。常用搭配：intervention in (干預...), humanitarian intervention (人道干預)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The government's early <target>intervention</target> <pattern>in</pattern> the economic crisis helped prevent the country from falling into a deeper depression.","translation":"政府在經濟危機早期的干預幫助該國免於陷入更深層的蕭條。","explanation":"名詞「干預」。指政府或權威機構採取行動以控制情況。"},{"sentence":"The school counselor's <target>intervention</target> was necessary to resolve the conflict between the two students before it turned into a physical fight.","translation":"學校輔導員的介入是必要的，以在衝突演變成肢體衝突之前解決兩名學生之間的矛盾。","explanation":"名詞「介入」。指第三方介入以解決問題。"},{"sentence":"International organizations often call for humanitarian <target>intervention</target> when a country's citizens are facing severe human rights abuses.","translation":"當一個國家的公民面臨嚴重的人權侵害時，國際組織經常呼籲進行人道干預。","explanation":"名詞「干預」。humanitarian intervention 指「人道干預」。"}],"related_forms":["intervene"]}

{"headword":"investigator","explanation":"名詞，意為「調查員」或「偵探」。指負責調查事件、犯罪或事故的人。常用搭配：private investigator (私人偵探), lead investigator (首席調查員)。","entries":[{"sentence":"The lead <target>investigator</target> spent several weeks analyzing the evidence found at the crime scene to identify the suspect.","translation":"首席調查員花了幾個星期分析在犯罪現場發現的證據，以識別嫌疑人。","explanation":"名詞「調查員」。指負責案件調查的專業人員。"},{"sentence":"After the plane crash, an independent <target>investigator</target> was hired to determine the exact cause of the accident and prevent future occurrences.","translation":"飛機失事後，一名獨立調查員被聘請來確定事故的確切原因並防止未來再次發生。","explanation":"名詞「調查員」。指對特定事故進行技術調查的人。"},{"sentence":"The company hired a private <target>investigator</target> to find out if any of its employees were leaking confidential information to competitors.","translation":"公司聘請了一名私人偵探來查明是否有任何員工將機密資訊洩漏給競爭對手。","explanation":"名詞「私人偵探」。private investigator 常指私人偵探。"}],"related_forms":["investigate","investigation"]}

{"headword":"irony","explanation":"名詞，意為「諷刺」。指實際情況與預期或表達的含義完全相反，導致一種幽默或悲劇性的效果。常用搭配：the irony of (...的諷刺之處)。","entries":[{"sentence":"It was a great <target>irony</target> that the man who spent his whole life studying safety rules eventually died in a simple accident.","translation":"這個花了一輩子研究安全規則的人最終死於一場簡單的意外，這真是極大的諷刺。","explanation":"名詞「諷刺」。指實際結果與預期完全相反。"},{"sentence":"The <target>irony</target> <pattern>of</pattern> the situation was that the fire station burned down while the firefighters were away on a training course.","translation":"這情況的諷刺之處在於，消防局在消防員們外出參加培訓課程時被燒毀了。","explanation":"名詞「諷刺」。片語 the irony of...。"},{"sentence":"He spoke with a touch of <target>irony</target> when he mentioned that his brand new expensive car had broken down on the first day.","translation":"當他提到他那輛嶄新且昂貴的汽車在第一天就故障時，說話帶著一絲諷刺。","explanation":"名詞「諷刺」。指說話語氣中的諷刺感。"}],"related_forms":["ironic","ironically"]}

{"headword":"journalism","explanation":"名詞，意為「新聞業」或「新聞學」。指收集、撰寫和報導新聞的專業活動。常用搭配：investigative journalism (調查報導), citizen journalism (公民新聞)。","entries":[{"sentence":"She decided to major in <target>journalism</target> because she wanted to hold powerful people accountable by reporting the truth to the public.","translation":"她決定主修新聞學，因為她想透過向大眾報導真相來讓權力者承擔責任。","explanation":"名詞「新聞學」。指大學的學科。"},{"sentence":"Investigative <target>journalism</target> plays a crucial role in a democratic society by exposing corruption and hidden scandals in the government.","translation":"調查報導在民主社會中扮演關鍵角色，透過揭露政府的腐敗和隱藏的醜聞。","explanation":"名詞「新聞業」。investigative journalism 指「調查報導」。"},{"sentence":"The rise of social media has changed the nature of <target>journalism</target>, allowing ordinary citizens to report news in real-time from anywhere.","translation":"社群媒體的興起改變了新聞業的性質，使得普通公民能夠從任何地方即時報導新聞。","explanation":"名詞「新聞業」。指整個行業。"}],"related_forms":["journalist","journalistic"]}
